title: New Clarity Act Draft Would Bar the President and Other Officials From Crypto Profits Through 2029
summary:
A new Senate draft of the crypto market structure bill finally includes an ethics provision limiting how the president and other officials profit from digital assets, but Democrats say it isn't enough.

The post New Clarity Act Draft Would Bar the President and Other Officials From Crypto Profits Through 2029 appeared first on Unchained.
full_text:
Senate negotiators on Wednesday circulated a new working draft of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act that, for the first time, includes the government ethics provision that has been the single biggest obstacle to the crypto market structure bill. The draft would prohibit the president, vice president, members of Congress, federal judges, and their spouses from issuing or sponsoring digital assets for compensation while in office.
Enforcement would fall to the Department of Justice, which could impose fines of up to $250,000 a day on violators. Officials who already hold digital assets could comply by selling them or placing them in a blind trust. Senator Cynthia Lummis, the Wyoming Republican leading the push, released the draft after President Trump reportedly signed off on the ethics language.
This story is an excerpt from the Unchained Daily newsletter.
Subscribe here to get these updates in your email for free
Trump’s crypto dealings have become the central obstacle to a bill the industry has sought for years. Trump reported roughly $1.4 billion in crypto-related income during his first year back in office, and Democrats have spent months trying to bar senior officials and their families from profiting off the industry, citing ventures like his stake in World Liberty Financial.
Seven Senate Democrats, including Ruben Gallego and Cory Booker, said in a joint statement that the most recent Clarity Act text “falls short” on ethics, consumer protection, and illicit finance. Senator Angela Alsobrooks has also reportedly called DOJ enforcement of the ethics rule “an unserious offer.”
The Clarity Act needs 60 votes, meaning at least seven Democrats to pass.
The timing is tight. The Senate leaves for its summer recess in a little over two weeks, and the first week of August is widely seen as the last practical chance to move the bill this year before attention shifts to the November midterms. Even if it passes the Senate, it would need to return to the House and then moved to Trump’s desk before becoming law.
Polymarket bettors most recently placed the odds of Clarity becoming law this year at 33%.

2026 年 7 月美伊衝突再度升級，荷姆茲海峽船舶通行量大減，布蘭特原油衝上每桶 93 美元、逼近六週高點。MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊指出，真正牽動股票、債券與加密資產定價的，不是單日油價漲跌，而是這波能源供應衝擊會不會重新推高通膨、逼聯準會維持高利率。市場過去依賴的「低通膨軟著陸」邏輯正被現實檢驗，而比特幣在突發的流動性衝擊中，短期仍比較像高波動的風險資產，還不能被簡單當成戰爭環境下的穩定避險工具。本文源自 MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊所著文章。
（前情提要：外媒爆料美伊停火協議延長 60 天！伊朗承諾 30 天內「清除水雷」重開荷姆茲海峽）
（背景補充：北約警告：伊朗若「封鎖荷姆茲海峽至 7 月」將出兵介入！國際油氣價格狂飆）
市場關注美伊衝突導致油流中斷，並不只是因為原油價格再度上漲。真正影響股票、債券和加密資產定價的問題是，能源供應衝擊會不會重新推高通膨，迫使聯準會維持高利率，甚至考慮進一步收緊政策。
2026 年 7 月，美伊軍事衝突再次升級，荷姆茲海峽船舶通行量大幅下降，紅海航線也面臨胡塞組織擴大封鎖的威脅。布蘭特原油於 7 月 22 日升至每桶 93 美元上方，接近六週高位。對於股市而言，核心問題已經從「衝突會持續多久」，轉向「企業盈利和估值能否承受更高能源成本、更高債券殖利率以及更弱消費需求的共同壓力」。
如果油流中斷只是短期事件，股票市場可能繼續依賴科技公司盈利和人工智慧投資維持韌性。但如果中斷持續數週甚至更久，投資人將不得不重新評估通膨、利率和全球增長的組合，風險資產的定價基礎也可能發生變化。
核心要點
- 美伊衝突已明顯壓縮荷姆茲海峽的油氣運輸能力，部分油輪暫停通行或改變航線。
- 布蘭特原油於 2026 年 7 月 22 日升至每桶 93.85 美元，西德州中級原油（WTI）升至 87.27 美元。
- 荷姆茲海峽在衝突前承載約全球五分之一的石油供應，是全球能源市場最重要的運輸節點之一。
- 股市面臨的核心問題不是單日油價上漲，而是能源衝擊會不會重新推高通膨和債券殖利率。
- 航空、運輸、化工、消費和高估值科技股面臨的壓力可能上升，能源、國防和部分原物料公司相對受益。
- 比特幣可能短期受到風險資產拋售影響，尚不能被簡單視為戰爭環境下的穩定避險資產。
- 投資人接下來應重點關注實際油流、油輪保險、美國通膨預期、美債殖利率和企業盈利指引。
荷姆茲油流中斷正在從風險情景變成現實
美伊衝突對市場的衝擊已經不再侷限於軍事行動本身。隨著美國恢復針對伊朗相關航運的海上封鎖，伊朗繼續襲擊海灣地區目標，荷姆茲海峽的商業船舶通行量明顯下降。
根據路透社對荷姆茲海峽航運的追蹤，7 月 16 日只有三艘原物料運輸船通過海峽，創下 5 月以來最低單日水平。當天沒有超大型原油運輸船和液化天然氣運輸船完成通行，部分油輪在阿曼灣附近停航或折返。
這意味著市場擔憂的不再只是伊朗是否正式宣布關閉海峽，而是船東、保險公司和能源貿易商是否已經因安全風險主動減少通行。
船舶減少本身就能形成供應衝擊
海峽不必被完全封鎖，全球油流也可能受到顯著影響。只要船東認為襲擊、扣押或軍事誤判的風險上升，油輪便可能延遲出港、改變航線或要求更高的運輸費用。
保險公司也可能提高戰爭險保費，縮短承保期限，或者拒絕為部分高風險航程提供保障。最終結果是，即使油田仍在生產，原油也未必能夠按照原定時間抵達煉油廠。
供應衝擊因此可能首先體現在運輸時效、現貨升水和煉油原料結構上，隨後才反映到官方出口數據。
紅海航線面臨第二重壓力
風險並不限於荷姆茲海峽。葉門胡塞組織威脅針對沙烏地相關船舶實施海上封鎖，並可能干擾曼德海峽附近航運。
美聯社關於胡塞組織航運威脅的報導指出，曼德海峽承載約 12% 的全球貿易。即使胡塞組織無法完全封鎖航道，零星無人機、導彈或水雷襲擊也可能迫使船舶繞行非洲南端。
如果荷姆茲海峽和曼德海峽同時受限，中東能源出口將面臨東西兩個方向的運輸壓力。全球市場需要考慮的將不再是單一海峽短期受阻，而是整個中東能源物流網絡出現相關性中斷。
油價上漲正在改變股市的宏觀假設
根據路透社 7 月 22 日能源市場報導，布蘭特原油上漲 3.12%，至每桶 93.85 美元，西德州中級原油上漲 3.47%，至 87.27 美元，兩者均升至 6 月 11 日以來最高水平。
油價上漲本身並不必然導致股市進入熊市。真正決定市場方向的是，油價處於高位的時間、供應中斷規模，以及企業和消費者能否吸收新增成本。
市場此前依賴通膨降溫邏輯
股票市場此前的重要支撐之一，是美國通膨逐步回落，允許聯準會停止升息，並在經濟放緩後保留降息空間。
能源供應衝擊可能破壞這一邏輯。原油價格上漲會首先影響汽油、柴油和航空燃油，隨後透過物流、塑膠、化工、農業和製造業成本傳導至更廣泛的商品和服務價格。
如果投資人開始相信能源通膨具有持續性，債券市場可能上調長期通膨補償，美債殖利率也可能隨之上升。高估值股票面臨的壓力將不僅來自盈利下調，也來自估值倍數收縮。
高油價可能製造增長和通膨並存的環境
對股市最不利的組合不是油價單獨上漲，而是油價上漲同時削弱消費和企業利潤。
家庭需要將更多收入用於燃油、電力和交通，其他非必需消費支出可能下降。企業則需要在提高售價、壓縮利潤率和削減成本之間作出選擇。
這種環境可能形成輕度停滯性通膨（滯脹）壓力。經濟增長放緩，但通膨無法迅速下降，聯準會因而難以透過降息提供支持。對於已經反映較高增長預期的股票而言，這一組合尤其不利。
股市核心問題是盈利能否抵消估值壓力
美伊衝突對股票市場的真正考驗，是企業盈利增長能否繼續快於融資成本和投入成本上升的速度。
此前部分主要股指能夠抵禦地緣政治衝擊，是因為大型科技公司盈利強勁，人工智慧資本支出繼續增長，銀行業績也保持韌性。然而，如果油價持續位於每桶 90 美元以上，市場需要重新判斷這些利多能否繼續抵消宏觀壓力。
科技股也無法脫離利率環境
大型科技公司通常不被視為原油成本的直接受害者，但其估值對長期利率高度敏感。
如果能源價格推高通膨預期，市場可能減少對降息的押注，十年期美債殖利率也可能上升。未來現金流折現率提高，會直接壓低高估值科技公司的理論價值。
人工智慧基礎設施還需要大量數據中心、電力、銅、天然氣和冷卻設備。能源成本上升不僅影響估值，也可能提高人工智慧資本支出的實際成本。
因此，科技股能否繼續引領市場，將取決於盈利增長是否足以覆蓋更高的折現率和基礎設施成本。
週期性行業面臨利潤率考驗
航空、航運、物流、汽車、化工和工業企業對燃料及原材料價格較為敏感。
部分企業可以透過燃油附加費或價格調整轉嫁成本，但傳導通常存在時滯。競爭激烈或需求疲軟的行業，可能難以將全部成本轉嫁給客戶。
零售和消費服務企業也可能受到間接影響。當家庭能源和交通開支上升時，餐飲、旅遊、娛樂及非必需品消費可能被壓縮。
能源股的上漲並非沒有邊界
油價上漲通常利多上游石油生產商和部分油田服務企業。現金流改善可能支持股利、庫藏股回購和資本支出。
但如果油價上漲最終引發全球經濟放緩，能源需求預期也會下降。煉油商、石化企業和高度依賴特定航線的公司，甚至可能因原料和物流錯配而承受壓力。
能源板塊因此可能成為短期相對贏家，但並不等於所有能源相關股票都會同步受益。
不同市場和行業將出現明顯分化
能源衝擊不會平均地作用於所有國家和資產。原油進口依賴度、貨幣穩定性、財政補貼能力和產業結構，將決定不同市場受到的實際影響。
亞洲原油進口國面臨更直接的壓力
印度、日本、韓國和部分東南亞經濟體高度依賴進口能源。油價上漲可能擴大貿易逆差，增加本國貨幣貶值壓力，並推高國內通膨。
路透社關於 7 月 13 日全球市場的報導顯示，美伊衝突重新升級後，油價單日上漲近 9%，全球股票市場承壓，債券殖利率上升。市場反應說明能源進口國不僅面臨企業成本上升，也可能同時承受資本流出和匯率壓力。
印度市場對油價變化尤其敏感，因為能源進口成本會直接影響通膨、財政支出和經常帳。對於需要透過補貼穩定燃油價格的政府而言，持續高油價還可能增加財政負擔。
美國市場存在行業內部避險
美國既是主要石油消費國，也是全球重要油氣生產國。高油價會壓縮消費者購買力，但也能提高頁岩油生產商和能源服務公司的收入。
這使美國股市擁有一定的行業內部避險能力。不過，由於主要股指權重高度集中於科技和消費公司，能源板塊上漲未必足以抵消大型成長股估值下降。
歐洲面臨能源安全和增長的雙重約束
歐洲在經歷此前天然氣危機後，能源結構已有一定調整，但對進口能源和全球航運仍較敏感。
油價、天然氣價格和運輸保險同時上升，可能再次提高歐洲工業成本。汽車、化工、航空和製造業面臨的壓力可能高於美國同類企業。
如果歐洲央行需要在弱增長和通膨反彈之間權衡，歐洲股票的風險溢價可能進一步上升。
投資人需要跟蹤哪些領先指標
軍事新聞能夠引發短線價格波動，但決定中期市場方向的仍是可以量化的油流、成本和金融條件。
實際船舶通行量
市場首先需要觀察荷姆茲海峽每日通過的原油運輸船、液化天然氣運輸船和成品油船數量。
如果船舶通行在數日內恢復，油價中的風險溢價可能迅速下降。如果通行量持續偏低，即使沒有正式封鎖，供應中斷也可能逐步反映到煉油廠庫存和現貨市場。
油輪運費和戰爭險保費
運費和保險費用可能比基準油價更早反映供應鏈壓力。
如果中東至亞洲或歐洲的油輪運費持續上升，說明實體貿易商仍在為運輸風險支付額外成本。即使布蘭特原油短期回落，終端能源成本也未必同步下降。
原油期限結構
現貨價格高於遠期價格的程度，可以反映市場對短期供應緊張的判斷。
如果近月合約升水擴大，說明煉油商和貿易商更願意為即時交付支付溢價。相反，如果遠期價格上漲但現貨結構沒有明顯收緊，部分漲幅可能更多來自風險溢價和金融交易。
美債殖利率和通膨預期
股市最關鍵的傳導渠道仍是債券市場。投資人應關注兩年期和十年期美債殖利率、抗通膨債券（TIPS）隱含預期，以及市場對聯準會政策路徑的重新定價。
如果油價上漲但長期通膨預期保持穩定，股票市場可能消化衝擊。如果殖利率和通膨預期同步上升，高估值資產面臨的壓力將明顯增加。
加密市場能否成為能源衝擊下的避險選擇
美伊衝突和油流中斷也會影響比特幣及其他數位資產，但傳導路徑並不單一。
比特幣具有固定供應上限，因此部分投資人可能將其視為對抗貨幣貶值和長期通膨的資產。然而，在突然發生的地緣政治衝擊中，比特幣通常仍會受到流動性收縮和風險資產拋售影響。
比特幣短期更接近高流動性風險資產
當油價上漲推動美元、美債殖利率和市場波動率上升時，槓桿投資人可能需要減少風險曝險。比特幣全天候交易且流動性較高，往往成為投資人迅速籌集現金的資產之一。
因此，衝突升級初期，比特幣可能與科技股同步下跌，而不是立即表現為黃金式的避險資產。
只有當市場開始將衝突解讀為長期財政擴張、貨幣貶值或資本管制風險時，比特幣的稀缺性敘事才可能重新獲得支持。
穩定幣需求可能獲得結構性支持
能源貿易、跨境結算和本國貨幣波動加劇，可能提高部分市場對美元穩定幣的需求。
穩定幣並不能消除發行方、儲備資產和監管風險，但其全天候轉移能力能夠在傳統銀行結算受限時提供補充管道。地緣政治衝突因此可能同時打擊加密資產價格，並提高穩定幣基礎設施的使用需求。
山寨幣面臨更高的流動性風險
如果能源衝擊導致全球金融條件收緊，資金通常會優先撤出流動性較弱、估值依賴遠期敘事的資產。
比特幣和以太坊可能獲得相對資金集中，但中小市值代幣、槓桿協議和高收益策略面臨更大的清算壓力。投資人不能因為比特幣具備潛在抗通膨屬性，就推斷整個加密市場都會從地緣政治風險中受益。
MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊獨家觀點
美伊衝突導致油流中斷真正重要的地方，不是布蘭特原油是否在某個交易日突破 90 美元，而是全球市場此前依賴的「低通膨軟著陸」邏輯正在受到現實檢驗。
過去一段時間，股票市場能夠容忍戰爭、關稅和財政風險，是因為投資人相信通膨最終會下降，企業盈利能夠增長，聯準會也保留降息空間。能源運輸一旦長期受阻，這三個假設可能同時受到挑戰。企業成本上升，消費者需求減弱，央行政策空間也會縮小。
市場可能誤讀的是，將油價上漲簡單視為能源股利多或航空股利空。真正的傳導核心在債券市場。如果能源價格沒有推高長期通膨預期，美伊衝突對股票估值的影響可能有限；如果油價、通膨預期和美債殖利率同步上升，即使企業當前盈利仍然穩健，估值也可能提前調整。
投資人接下來最應關注的不是軍事行動次數，而是荷姆茲海峽實際運輸量、油輪保險費用、布蘭特原油期限結構和美國通膨預期。這些指標能夠幫助判斷衝突是否已經從新聞衝擊轉化為持續的經濟衝擊。
對加密市場而言，最大的啟發是比特幣的宏觀資產屬性正在增強，但這種屬性並不等於穩定避險。比特幣可能長期受益於貨幣貶值擔憂，同時在短期流動性衝擊中與科技股同步下跌。跨資產投資人需要區分「長期稀缺性邏輯」與「短期風險曝險」，而不是用單一標籤定義比特幣。
常見問題
美伊衝突為什麼會導致油流中斷？
荷姆茲海峽連接波斯灣與外部海域，是沙烏地阿拉伯、伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、卡達和阿聯能源出口的重要通道。軍事封鎖、無人機襲擊和船舶安全風險會迫使油輪暫停通行或改變航線。即使海峽未被完全關閉，保險、運費和交付時間上升也會減少有效供應。
荷姆茲海峽對全球石油市場有多重要？
衝突爆發前，約全球五分之一的石油供應透過荷姆茲海峽運輸。該地區還承擔大量液化天然氣和成品油出口。由於短期內缺乏足夠的替代管道和航線，任何持續中斷都可能迅速影響亞洲和歐洲煉油廠的原料供應，並推高全球能源價格。
油價上漲為什麼會壓低股票市場？
油價上漲會提高運輸、製造、化工和農業成本，並減少家庭可用於其他消費的收入。如果能源通膨推高整體物價，聯準會可能延後降息，債券殖利率也可能上升。企業盈利下降和估值折現率提高同時出現時，股票市場通常面臨更大的調整壓力。
哪些股票可能從油價上漲中受益？
擁有穩定產量和較低開採成本的上游石油公司、部分油田服務企業及能源基礎設施營運商可能受益。國防和部分原物料公司也可能獲得資金關注。不過，如果高油價最終造成經濟衰退，能源需求和企業估值也可能下降，因此能源股並非沒有風險。
哪些行業最容易受到油流中斷影響？
航空、物流、航運、汽車、化工、工業製造和非必需消費行業通常對燃料和運輸成本較為敏感。能源進口依賴度較高的亞洲和歐洲企業還可能面臨匯率壓力。無法及時提高售價或缺乏長期燃料避險的公司，利潤率受到的影響可能更明顯。
油價升至 100 美元會導致股市崩盤嗎？
油價突破 100 美元並不必然導致股市崩盤。關鍵取決於高油價持續多久、經濟增長是否放緩、企業能否轉嫁成本，以及央行如何回應。如果油價短暫衝高後回落，市場可能迅速修復；如果供應中斷持續並推高核心通膨，股票估值和盈利預期可能同時下調。
比特幣能否在美伊衝突中充當避險資產？
比特幣可能在長期貨幣貶值和資本流動受限的環境中獲得需求，但短期表現仍高度依賴全球流動性。衝突升級時，投資人可能出售比特幣以降低風險或補充保證金。因此，比特幣有時能夠體現稀缺資產屬性，但並不是穩定、無波動的戰爭避險工具。
投資人接下來最應該關注什麼？
最值得關注的是荷姆茲海峽船舶通行量、曼德海峽安全狀況、油輪戰爭險、布蘭特原油近月價差、美債殖利率和美國通膨預期。如果這些指標同時惡化，說明衝突正在轉化為持續的宏觀衝擊。單獨觀察油價或股指可能不足以判斷風險方向。
*本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議。加密資產、股票與原物料市場波動劇烈，投資前請審慎評估自身風險承受能力。*

title: BitMEX 落幕回首：曾養大整個加密世界的交易所，Arthur Hayes 從未真正離開
summary:
BitMEX 宣布將在 2026 年 9 月 23 日正式關閉，結束 11 年營運。這家由 Arthur Ha […]

〈BitMEX 落幕回首：曾養大整個加密世界的交易所，Arthur Hayes 從未真正離開〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
BitMEX 宣布將在 2026 年 9 月 23 日正式關閉，結束 11 年營運。這家由 Arthur Hayes、Ben Delo、Samuel Reed 三人白手起家的交易所，發明了永續合約與 100 倍槓桿，定義了整個加密衍生品時代，某種程度幣安、Bybit 都是它的模仿者。2020 年遭美國司法部起訴後，它逐漸被後來者超越；而創辦人 Arthur Hayes 離場後，反而以宏觀分析成為圈內最有份量的聲音之一。
（前情提要：川普特赦 Arthur Hayes 等三名 BitMEX 聯創，CZ 發文賀喜）
（背景補充：Arthur Hayes 家族辦公室籌募 2.5 億美元基金！瞄準持股加密實體公司）
重點摘要
- BitMEX 將於 2026 年 9 月 23 日關閉，結束 11 年營運，為母公司 HDR Global 策略檢討後的決定
- 2014 年由 Arthur Hayes 等三人創立，發明永續合約與 100 倍槓桿，首年交易量破 10 億美元、2018 年成全球最大衍生品所
- 2020 年遭美國司法部起訴違反《銀行保密法》，2025 年獲川普特赦；Arthur Hayes 離場後掌管 Maelstrom，成圈內宏觀分析要角
2026 年 9 月 23 日，BitMEX 會正式關掉它的前端伺服器。這家交易所營運了 11 年，不是被駭客擊垮，不是資不抵債，官方強調資產大於負債。只是在母公司 HDR Global Trading 的一次策略檢討之後，BitMEX 安靜地決定不玩了。
BitMEX 熄燈的那一天，幣安、Bybit、OKX，每一家還開著的加密交易所，主力產品都還是同一種合約。那種合約沒有到期日，可以用一小筆保證金押上百倍的部位。它有個名字叫「永續合約」。而第一個把永續合約做出來、讓它跑起來的，就是即將關門的 BitMEX。
三個沒被看好的創辦人
故事要從 2014 年說起，那年，三個人湊在一起做了 BitMEX，全名是 Bitcoin Mercantile Exchange。他們沒有大筆融資，也沒有華爾街的背書。
Arthur Hayes 是被裁掉的銀行交易員，先後待過德意志銀行和花旗，在香港做股票衍生品，金融海嘯後的裁員潮把他掃了出來。
Ben Delo 是牛津出身的數學家，寫得出能扛住高頻交易的程式。
Samuel Reed 是工程師，負責把整套系統搭起來。
三個人一個懂市場、一個懂數學、一個懂工程，這是很典型的草創組合。
Hayes 看到的是沒有人做服務的縫隙。當時的比特幣市場只能買現貨，想放槓桿、想避險、想做空，幾乎沒有像樣的工具。傳統券商不碰加密貨幣，加密圈又沒人會做衍生品。
他們推出的答案，是永續合約。這個產品沒有到期日，透過每 8 小時結算一次的資金費率，讓合約價格緊貼現貨。BitMEX 把它命名為 XBTUSD，掛上 100 倍槓桿，全部用比特幣結算。這意味著你可以用 1 塊錢的比特幣，去押 100 塊錢的部位。
市場的反應很直接，BitMEX 上線第一天，就做出 5,000 萬美元的交易量。第一年，累積交易量突破 10 億美元。
（但老實說，我們不知道有沒有刷量，如果有，那BitMEX大機率也是第一個刷量的交易所。）
後來每家CEX都在抄它
到了 2018 年，BitMEX 已經是全球交易量最大的加密衍生品交易所。它的永續合約成了整個產業的範本。
幣安的合約部門 Binance Futures、Bybit、後來的 FTX，這些名字你可能更熟，但它們的旗艦產品，本質上都是 BitMEX 設計的翻版。永續合約從一個交易所的實驗，變成加密市場的空氣，無所不在。加密交易也從單純的買低賣高，變成隨時能加到百倍槓桿的賭桌，而這張賭桌的規則是 BitMEX 寫的。
這種事在科技史上其實不新鮮，Netscape 在 1990 年代發明了第一個真正好用的網頁瀏覽器，定義了整個上網的方式，然後被微軟的 IE 輾過去，公司本身早就消失了。但 Netscape 留下的東西，像 SSL 加密、JavaScript、cookie，到今天你每次上網都還在用。發明規則的人，未必是最後坐在牌桌上的人。
當司法部來敲門
BitMEX 的轉折點，來得又快又硬。
2019 年 7 月，Arthur Hayes 與「末日博士」Nouriel Roubini 因應動區邀請，兩人來到台北的「亞洲區塊鏈高峰會」（ABS）展開世紀辯論，兩人在加密貨幣議題上交鋒，分別代表了傳統凱因斯經濟學派與加密貨幣極端信仰者的碰撞。
Arthur Hayes 認為，加密貨幣能讓資產遠離政府與大企業的監控，為人們帶來真正的金融自主權。
Nouriel Roubini 則猛烈抨擊加密貨幣是「Shitcoin」（垃圾幣），痛批 BitMEX 交易所市場秩序亂七八糟，缺乏監管，只是利用高槓桿吸金的腐敗行為。
但 Hayes 當場的說法，卻讓聽眾不得不支持他，他點出比特幣為列的加密貨幣，僅是多給予人們選擇的自由，去監管的交易和資產隱私，就已經勝過許多法幣。
末日博士作為美國中心的經濟學家，看似不太開心，這也可能為 Arthur Hayes 的未來埋下了地雷。
地雷爆得很快，2020 年 10 月，美國司法部與商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）同時出手，起訴 BitMEX 三位創辦人，以及業務發展主管、也是公司第一號員工的 Gregory Dwyer。罪名的核心是違反《銀行保密法》，也就是這家交易所多年來沒有落實該做的反洗錢與客戶身分審查（KYC）。
老實說，當時 BitMEX 幾乎不問用戶是誰，就讓你開百倍槓桿。
Arthur Hayes 隨即卸下執行長職務。接下來的時間線是這樣走的：2021 年，他到夏威夷向美國當局投案，交保 1,000 萬美元獲釋；2022 年，他認罪，被判 6 個月居家監禁、2 年緩刑，外加 1,000 萬美元的刑事罰款。Ben Delo、Samuel Reed 也各自付出代價。
在美國大棒沈重一擊之後，BitMEX 就再也沒回到它的高峰。合規枷鎖加身，用戶被要求驗證身分，那些愛用它的匿名玩家轉頭去了別家。幣安趁勢吃下大半市場，把 BitMEX 讓出來的位子坐得又穩又滿。
BitMEX 教會了所有人怎麼做這門生意，然後被這門生意的新王者超越。
交易所倒下，那個人卻站得更高
如果故事只到這裡，那不過是又一家盛極而衰的交易所。真正有意思的是 Arthur Hayes 這個人接下來的走向。
2025 年 3 月 28 日，川普簽署完全且無條件的特赦，一次抹除了 Arthur Hayes、Ben Delo、Samuel Reed 與 Gregory Dwyer 的重罪記錄。法律上的那頁就此翻過。
但 Hayes 早在被定罪之前，就已經開始經營另一個身分。他離開 BitMEX 的日常營運後，成立了家族辦公室 Maelstrom，2025 年募了一支 2.5 億美元的基金，專門押注早期的基礎設施、DeFi 與 Web3 協議。他現在的頭銜是 Maelstrom 的投資長。
更關鍵的是他很會寫文章，Arthur Hayes 的部落格長文，是加密圈少數能被反覆轉載、逐字研究的宏觀分析。他把聯準會的政策、逆回購市場的數字、地緣政治的角力，翻譯成一般人看得懂、也用得上的交易策略，字裡行間帶著他的黑色幽默和一大堆迷因。
圈內給他一個稱號，叫「宏觀大師」，他寫一篇看多比特幣的文章，市場情緒真的會跟著動。在社群上，他則是知名的喊單後偷賣的大師。
一個時代的結束
BitMEX 的收尾很有秩序。8 月 26 日起，用戶只能減倉，不能開新部位；關閉當天，還沒平掉的部位會被強制清算；完成 KYC 的用戶得趕在關門前把資產提走，否則要付帳戶管理費。它甚至提醒用戶小心趁亂而來的釣魚詐騙。一家把百倍槓桿帶進加密世界的交易所，最後選擇了安靜、克制的退場。
BitMEX 關掉的只是伺服器。
它發明的永續合約今天還在全球每一張加密交易的桌上運轉，每天扛著數千億美元的成交量。從這個角度看，Arthur Hayes 其實從來不需要 BitMEX 還開著，才能證明自己贏了。他要的東西早就長進了整個產業的骨頭裡，這間交易所已經證明了自己。
常見問題
BitMEX 為什麼要關閉？
BitMEX 母公司 HDR Global Trading 於 2026 年經策略檢討後決定關閉交易所，9 月 23 日正式停止營運，結束 11 年歷史。它並非因駭客或資不抵債倒閉，官方強調資產大於負債，並要求用戶在關閉前提領資產。
永續合約和 BitMEX 有什麼關係？
BitMEX 在 2016 年推出永續合約 XBTUSD，這是一種沒有到期日、可用 100 倍槓桿交易的衍生品。這個設計後來被幣安、Bybit、OKX 等交易所廣泛採用，成為加密衍生品市場的主流產品。

title: BitMEX 宣布收攤！9 月 23 日正式關閉交易平台、即日停止註冊，永續合約祖師爺走入歷史
summary:
老牌加密衍生品交易所 BitMEX 宣布，將於 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00（UTC）正式關閉交 […]

〈BitMEX 宣布收攤！9 月 23 日正式關閉交易平台、即日停止註冊，永續合約祖師爺走入歷史〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
老牌加密衍生品交易所 BitMEX 宣布，將於 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00（UTC）正式關閉交易平台，即日起停止所有新用戶註冊。母公司 HDR Global Trading Limited 董事會表示，這是對公司業務與整個加密產業進行戰略評估後的決定。平台強烈建議用戶盡快平倉、提領資金，並提醒未在期限前提現的用戶，將被收取每月最低 50 美元的帳號管理費。這間開創「永續合約」品類、曾是全球最大加密衍生品交易所的先驅，就此要走入歷史。
（前情提要：川普特赦 Arthur Hayes 等三名 BitMEX 聯創，CZ 發文賀喜）
（背景補充：CFTC 聲明：BitMEX 三名創辦人因非法營運、違反洗錢條例，判處 3,000 萬鎂罰款）
重點摘要
- BitMEX 宣布 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00 UTC 關閉交易平台，即日起停止新用戶註冊，由母公司 HDR Global 董事會戰略評估後決定
- 8 月 26 日起實施風險限制只能減倉，關閉前未平倉部位將被強制平倉，交易損失平台概不負責
- 關閉後僅保留資產託管，已完成 KYC 但未提現的用戶每月收 50 美元或年化 1%（取較高者）管理費
加密衍生品的一個時代要結束了。BitMEX 宣布，交易平台將在 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00（UTC）正式關閉，即日起停止所有新用戶註冊。母公司 HDR Global Trading Limited 董事會給出的理由，是「對公司業務及整個加密產業進行戰略評估」後的結果。平台強烈建議所有用戶盡快平倉、提領資金。
據 BitMEX 官方公告，這不是被駭、也不是任何財務問題，而是母公司算完帳後主動決定收攤。對開創了永續合約、曾經養活整個加密衍生品市場的交易所來說，這樣的退場意外地安靜。
兩階段收攤，8 月 26 日起只能減倉
BitMEX 給了一份明確的退場時間表。在關閉之前，平台會繼續正常營運，但從 2026 年 8 月 26 日 04:00（UTC）起實施風險限制，用戶將無法開設新部位只能減倉。此後，平台會逐步強制平倉現有部位，讓市場有序退出，截至關閉時間仍未平倉的部位，會被立即強制平倉。
平台把話說得很白，對用戶未能及時平倉造成的交易損失，一概不負責。此外，流動性不足的合約會提前結算，BitMEX 表示會按照慣例提前通知相關用戶。換句話說，想全身而退，最好別拖到最後一刻。
不提現要付錢，每月 50 鎂或年化 1%
交易關閉之後 BitMEX 不再提供任何交易服務，只保留資產託管功能。用戶仍然可以登入帳號查看錢包餘額、歷史交易紀錄，並繼續提領資產。平台也已經解除所有 BMEX 質押，相關代幣現已返還到用戶帳號。
比較要留意的是管理費，對於已完成 KYC、但沒有在關閉時間前完成提現的用戶，BitMEX 會開始收取帳號管理費，標準是每月按帳號餘額計費，金額為 50 美元或年化 1%（取較高者）。平台還預告，如果用戶長期不提現，未來收費標準可能進一步提高。這等於是在催促用戶要把錢趕快領走。
永續合約祖師爺再見
BitMEX 在加密圈的地位並不普通。它 2014 年由 Arthur Hayes、Ben Delo 與 Samuel Reed 創辦，最為人所知的，是率先推出「永續合約」這種沒有到期日的槓桿商品，一度提供高達 100 倍槓桿，在 2018 到 2020 年間坐穩全球最大加密衍生品交易所的位置。
可以說，後來幣安、Bybit、OKX 這些交易主打的衍生品戰爭，玩法都是從 BitMEX 這裡學來的。
轉折點出現在 2020 年，美國司法部與商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）起訴 BitMEX，指控其違反《銀行保密法》、未建立反洗錢與 KYC 機制。三名創辦人後續認罪，Arthur Hayes 被判兩年緩刑，平台也付出巨額罰款和解。此後 BitMEX 的市佔一路下滑，早已不復當年霸主風光。
2025 年，川普（Donald Trump）特赦了三名創辦人，替這段官司畫下句點，沒想到一年後，交易所本身也走到了終點。
常見問題
BitMEX 什麼時候關閉？用戶要做什麼？
BitMEX 交易平台將於 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00 UTC 關閉。用戶應在 8 月 26 日風險限制上路前處理好部位，並在關閉前提領所有資金。未平倉部位會被強制平倉，未提現且完成 KYC 的用戶還會被收取每月 50 美元或年化 1% 的管理費。
BitMEX 為什麼要關閉交易平台？
依官方公告，母公司 HDR Global Trading Limited 董事會在對公司業務與整個加密產業進行戰略評估後，決定關閉交易平台。這並非破產或遭駭，而是主動的商業決定。BitMEX 是永續合約先驅，曾為全球最大加密衍生品交易所，近年市佔大幅下滑。

title: Uber 創辦人 AI 新創 ATOMS 吸金 17 億鎂，a16z 領投，老東家 Uber 也回頭押注
summary:
Uber 共同創辦人 Travis Kalanick 週三（7/22）在 X 發文宣布，旗下新創 ATOMS […]

〈Uber 創辦人 AI 新創 ATOMS 吸金 17 億鎂，a16z 領投，老東家 Uber 也回頭押注〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Uber 共同創辦人 Travis Kalanick 週三（7/22）在 X 發文宣布，旗下新創 ATOMS 完成 17 億美元股權融資，由創投巨頭 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）領投，a16z 共同創辦人 Ben Horowitz 將加入 ATOMS 董事會。這輪融資期間，Travis Kalanick 把 CloudKitchens 等多項業務整併進 ATOMS 的統一股權架構，連在 2017 年把他掃地出門的老東家 Uber 都回頭投了錢。
（前情提要：a16z 募資 150 億美元「確保美國勝利」：百年內將持續在科技領先）
（背景補充：WSJ：貝佐斯計劃成立 1000 億美元基金，收購老牌製造業公司利用 AI 轉型）
重點摘要
- ATOMS 完成 17 億美元股權融資，a16z 領投，共同創辦人 Ben Horowitz 加入 ATOMS 董事會
- ATOMS 是 CloudKitchens 母公司 City Storage Systems 於 2026 年 3 月更名而來，整併 Otter、Picnic、Lab37 等業務
- 投資陣容含 Bain Capital、Fifth Wall 與老東家 Uber，另有高盛、摩根大通等 5 大銀行提供債權融資
離開 Uber 八年之後，Travis Kalanick 帶著一家外界幾乎搞不懂在做什麼的公司，一口氣募到 17 億美元。這位 Uber 共同創辦人週三（7/22）在 X 發文證實，他一手打造的 ATOMS 完成 17 億美元股權融資，由矽谷創投巨頭 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）領投，a16z 共同創辦人 Ben Horowitz 將親自進駐 ATOMS 董事會。
據 TechCrunch 報導，最耐人尋味的是出資名單，裡頭赫然出現 Uber。那個在 2017 年因企業文化爭議把 Travis Kalanick 拉下執行長寶座、逼他出走的老東家，這回竟然回頭投了錢。當年的難堪與今日的加碼擺在一起，本身就是這則新聞最好看的註腳。
除了 a16z 領投，這輪股權投資方還拉來 Bain Capital、Fifth Wall、K5 Global、SV Angel、Alpha Square Group 等一票創投；債權端則由美國銀行（Bank of America）、高盛（Goldman Sachs）、富國銀行（Wells Fargo）、摩根大通（JPMorgan）與巴克萊（Barclays）五大銀行撐腰。
Travis Kalanick 把這輪定調為「未竟之業」（unfinished business），指的是 2011 年他在 Uber 時期差點就和 a16z 的 Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz 聯手，卻擦身而過，這回總算補上。
某種程度上，這輪融資是一件未竟之業，是把當年在 Uber 啟動、經 CloudKitchens 延續的「從位元到原子」故事線走完的燃料。
ATOMS 到底是什麼
講到這裡，多數人大概還是一頭霧水：ATOMS 到底在做什麼？答案是，它其實不算一家全新的公司。ATOMS 是 CloudKitchens 母公司 City Storage Systems 在 2026 年 3 月的品牌重塑。
Travis Kalanick 自 2017 年離開 Uber 後，就一直低調經營這攤幽靈廚房（ghost kitchen，只接外送、沒有內用座位的中央廚房）生意，一藏就是八年。今年 3 月他把招牌掀開，宣布把旗下多項業務全部收進 ATOMS 這個母公司底下：
- CloudKitchens：核心的幽靈廚房與外送廚房基礎設施
- Otter：餐廳用的訂單整合作業系統
- Picnic：辦公室午餐外送服務
- Lab37：自動組餐（自動做餐盒）技術
說穿了，ATOMS 是 Travis Kalanick 把手上一堆餐飲、物流、自動化業務打包成的控股集團，對外掛的旗號則是「實體 AI」（physical AI），也就是把 AI 和機器人塞進那些過去被科技業繞開的傳統重工業。
這回賭的是礦場、工地和餐廳後廚
ATOMS 底下切成三塊業務：Atoms Food（食品基礎設施）、Atoms Mining（號稱打造「更高產能的礦場」）、Atoms Transport（自我定位是「機器人的底盤」）。為了把礦業自動化這塊做起來，Travis Kalanick 還收購了 Pronto，那是他的前 Uber 同事 Anthony Levandowski 一手經營的自駕與工業自動化公司，專攻礦區與工地的無人載具。
Travis Kalanick 口中的「原子」（atoms），指的正是採礦、營建、重型運輸、食品生產這些「動手做實體東西」的產業，對照的是矽谷過去二十年只忙著搬「位元」（bits）、把軟體做上雲。他賭的是下一波 AI 紅利不在螢幕裡，而在礦坑、工地和餐廳後廚。
17 億美元的彈藥、五大銀行的債權背書，再加上一個進了董事會的 Ben Horowitz，Travis Kalanick 這次要證明的，是那套讓 Uber 改寫城市交通的打法，能不能原封不動搬到採礦機和自動炒菜鍋上。至於這是遠見還是又一場燒錢豪賭，市場會慢慢給出答案。
常見問題
ATOMS 是什麼公司？
ATOMS 是 Uber 共同創辦人 Travis Kalanick 旗下的控股集團，2026 年 3 月由 CloudKitchens 母公司 City Storage Systems 更名而來，整合餐飲、物流與自動化業務，主攻採礦、運輸、食品三大領域的機器人與「實體 AI」應用。
Travis Kalanick 的 ATOMS 這輪融資規模多大？
ATOMS 完成 17 億美元股權融資，由 a16z 領投，Bain Capital、Fifth Wall 與老東家 Uber 等參投，另有高盛、摩根大通等五大銀行提供債權融資，a16z 共同創辦人 Ben Horowitz 加入董事會。

title: 學生好心教加密貨幣卻被告！國小老師虧錢要他「高價買回BTC」還求償700萬
summary:
新竹一名國小美術老師 2017 年拜託昔日學生幫忙開戶、代操虛擬貨幣，前後匯了 782 萬元買以太幣、比特幣和 […]

〈學生好心教加密貨幣卻被告！國小老師虧錢要他「高價買回BTC」還求償700萬〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
新竹一名國小美術老師 2017 年拜託昔日學生幫忙開戶、代操虛擬貨幣，前後匯了 782 萬元買以太幣、比特幣和瑞波幣。行情大好時學生勸他獲利了結，他一句「資產上億再收手」擋了回去，最後全數賠光。多年後他反過來告學生詐欺，要求賠 700 萬元，新竹地方法院審理後認定沒有詐欺，且雙方早已用 5 萬元和解結清，判老師敗訴，全案駁回。
（前情提要：上百位小資女受洗腦！「影視幣」詐騙案吸金上億，講座、101 商辦、保證獲利奏效）
（背景補充：台灣比特幣狂熱：幣託註冊數與交易活躍雙創新高，APP 財經類排名衝第二）
重點摘要
- 新竹地院判決，陳姓美術老師 2017 年匯 782 萬元委學生代操虛擬貨幣，全數賠光後告詐欺求償 700 萬遭駁回
- 學生曾在獲利破百萬時勸老師撤資，老師以「資產上億再收手」拒絕，法院認定風險應自負、無詐欺
- 雙方 2024 年 6 月已用 5 萬元折抵 700 萬達成和解、親筆「兩造結清」，債務消滅無從再請求
投資賠錢卻把錯怪在別人身上，是可能發生的情況，所以千萬別隨便教人投資，干涉他人因果。新竹地方法院日前審結一起虛擬貨幣投資糾紛，一名陳姓國小美術老師 2017 年間透過昔日學生游男的協助，開戶並代操以太幣、比特幣與瑞波幣，前後匯入游男帳戶的金額高達 782 萬 6,000 元。
老師事後虧損，卻主張自己被學生詐騙，起訴以前的學生並求償 700 萬元，法院審理後認定沒有詐欺事實，且雙方早已和解，判決老師全部敗訴，連假執行的聲請也一併駁回。
案子最耐人尋味的地方，是原告和被告的關係。游男是陳師的國小學生，2017 年幫忙代操加密貨幣時已經是實習醫生，一邊要跑醫院實習、值班，另準備國家考試，兩人之間沒有簽任何委任契約，也沒約定報酬，純粹是師生情誼下的幫忙。
獲利破百萬卻要「資產上億再收手」
依判決書還原的過程，陳師從 2017 年 5 月 10 日到 12 月 26 日，分 11 筆陸續匯款到游男帳戶，買進以太幣、比特幣、比特幣現金與瑞波幣，單筆最大的兩筆各是 200 萬元。2017 年正是台灣加密投資最狂熱的時期，以太幣、比特幣年內大漲，陳師的帳面一度獲利破百萬。
問題出在他不肯下車，游男當時就傳訊提醒：「老師，你的資金什麼時候要撤出，這麼多錢放在高風險的投機商品，我每天壓力都很大，目前獲利已超過 100 萬。」陳師卻以「資產上億再收手」為由拒絕。這句話後來成了他敗訴的關鍵之一。
接著行情反轉，陳師開始頻繁下單追價，判決書裡引用了他自己的對話：「主力騙線，手腳做得很像，我因為心裡焦急，輕易地上當」、「比來比去還是不動最賺」，甚至傳過「XX請你接棒（代操）」、「把我的權限關掉」。這些訊息反而證明了一件事，帳戶的操作權限一直在陳師手上，是他自己在盤中殺進殺出。
好心接下 0.9 顆比特幣，還被告討 700 萬
後來帳戶因為異常交易被 Bittrex 交易所鎖定，裡頭剩下約 0.9 顆比特幣。陳師要求游男以歷史最高價每顆 7.2 萬美元把本金贖回給他，游男主張當時市價其實只有約 170 萬元。最諷刺的是，這位「好心學生」最後還是分期掏了 270 萬元，把老師套牢的這 0.9 顆比特幣接了下來。
本以為事情就此了結，陳師卻在 2024 年再度找上門追討。游男先是在同年 6 月 1 日簽下還款協議書，承諾五年內按月清償 700 萬元。但過幾天，2024 年 6 月 24 日，雙方在游男父母出面協調後達成和解，議定 700 萬元的協議書作廢、以 5 萬元折抵，陳師還親筆寫下「陳（師）本人也不再追究，兩造結清」，全程錄影存證。
茲游（男）原承諾歸還陳（師）投資游（男）柒佰萬損失，考量當事人還款能力與意願，今雙方立約協議，議定柒佰萬還款協議以五萬元折抵，原還款柒佰萬協議書作廢，（陳師）本人也不再追究，兩造結清。
（判決書內記載 113 年 6 月 24 日和解文件）
照理說白紙黑字加錄影，這事該畫下句點，陳師卻仍拿著那張已作廢的 700 萬協議書提告，主張和解是被對方家人以「會走上絕路」的說法騙來的，要依民法撤銷。
法院打臉：投資風險自負
法院沒有接受陳師的說法，承審法官指出，主張詐欺的一方要負舉證責任，但陳師提出的錄音、對話截圖，只能看到他在投資失利後不斷質問游男，證明不了游男有拖延開戶或提供不實資訊詐騙的行為。相反地，游男不只沒保證獲利，還多次提醒風險、建議撤資，很難認定他主觀上有詐欺的故意。
法官更直接點出，陳師身為教師，是有相當智識的成年人，「正常智識之人應理解投資本即蘊藏風險，尤其高獲利伴隨高風險，並無穩賺之理」，投資報酬不如預期的風險本來就該自己承擔。至於那 700 萬元，雙方 2024 年 6 月的和解早已讓債務消滅，陳師也拿不出證據證明自己是被詐欺才簽和解，最終全案駁回。
一場師生情誼的幫忙，換來多年官司和煩惱。這起判決給所有想「順便帶人入門投資」的人一個提醒，行情好的時候人人都有明牌，賠錢的時候，法院只認你是不是自己做決定。
常見問題
幫別人代操虛擬貨幣賠錢要負責嗎？
依這起新竹地院判決，若雙方沒有委任契約、代操者未保證獲利也未施用詐術，且投資人自己保有操作權限，投資虧損屬市場風險，應由投資人自負。本案代操學生因曾提醒風險、建議撤資，法院認定無詐欺責任，判免賠。
投資糾紛簽了和解書還能再告嗎？
原則上不行。依民法第 736、737 條，和解有消滅原有權利的效力。本案雙方 2024 年 6 月以 5 萬元折抵 700 萬元並親筆寫下「兩造結清」，法院認定 700 萬債務已消滅，除非能舉證和解本身受詐欺，否則無法再依原協議求償。

title: SEC 盯上鏈上借貸，比特幣抵押貸款加速「搬進託管」
summary:
SEC 委員 Hester Peirce（圈內人稱「加密老媽」）週三（7/22）示警，DeFi 金庫與鏈上借貸 […]

〈SEC 盯上鏈上借貸，比特幣抵押貸款加速「搬進託管」〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
SEC 委員 Hester Peirce（圈內人稱「加密老媽」）週三（7/22）示警，DeFi 金庫與鏈上借貸協議只要牽涉利率、抵押與清算門檻的決策，就可能落入證券法或投資顧問規範。這番表態正把比特幣抵押借貸市場推向兩條路，一邊是靠託管與資產隔離撐起合規門面的 CeFi 業者，Ledn 未償放款已衝上 7.14 億美元，另一邊是仍以智能合約撮合的 DeFi 借貸池。
（前情提要：加密金庫與借貸恐踩紅線？「加密老媽」Hester Peirce 示警：上鏈不等於脫離證券法）
（背景補充：美國 SEC 委員 Hester Peirce 是誰？人稱加密老媽、全球監管影響力巨大）
重點摘要
- SEC 委員 Hester Peirce 示警，DeFi 金庫與鏈上借貸若決定利率、抵押、清算門檻，恐落入證券法或投資顧問規範
- 監管壓力推動比特幣借貸走向託管化，Ledn 未償放款達 7.14 億美元、2018 年起累計放款破 100 億美元
- 市場分兩派，CeFi 靠託管吸引長期持有者，DeFi 借貸池仍以智能合約撮合 BTC、ETH 與穩定幣抵押
把借貸搬上鏈，不代表就能繞開證券法。SEC 委員 Hester Peirce（圈內人稱「加密老媽」）週三（7/22）一番表態，看似只是重申監管立場，卻在比特幣借貸這門生意裡投下變數。她點名 DeFi 金庫（vault）與鏈上借貸協議，只要牽涉利率、抵押要求與清算門檻的決策，就可能落入現有證券法或投資顧問規範。而市場的反應，是加速「搬進託管」。
監管這次要看的，是協議怎麼設計
Peirce 的核心論點很直接，把一項金融活動搬到區塊鏈上，並不會自動改變它的法律地位。她強調每個結構都得看具體事實逐一評估，而不是一刀切歸類。
她把金庫攤開成一道光譜，一端是完全自動化的智能合約，另一端則是由管理者或策展人（curator）挑選投資策略、再平衡資產、甚至指派他人代為決策的產品。後者，在 Peirce 眼中就可能長得像投資公司或投資顧問，落入既有的證券法規範。鏈上借貸也是同一套邏輯，誰來決定利率、抵押要求、支援哪些資產，都可能觸發證券法問題。
把金融活動搬上鏈，不會讓它自動脫離聯邦證券法。每一種結構都需要依事實逐案判斷，而不是套用一個籠統的分類。
過去 SEC 盯的是「這顆代幣算不算證券」，現在連「協議背後是誰、用什麼方式在做決策」都要拿放大鏡看。
比特幣借貸市場，正加速「搬進託管」
監管的壓力還沒落地成罰單，市場已經先動了。以比特幣抵押借貸為主的中心化業者（CeFi），正靠著託管服務與資產隔離，吸引不想賣掉 BTC、只想換取法幣流動性的長期持有者。
例如比特幣借貸平台 Ledn 目前未償放款達 7.14 億美元，對應 19,685 枚 BTC，自 2018 年成立以來累計處理放款超過 100 億美元，光是 2025 年單年放款就突破 10 億美元。它的賣點是把客戶抵押品與自家營運資金分離，避開了上一輪週期壓垮多家借貸商的那種資產混用風險。
- Ledn: 未償放款 7.14 億美元（19,685 枚 BTC），客戶抵押品與營運資金分離
- Strike: 主打防波動貸款，消除價格觸發的強制清算，還款條件彈性
- Unchained: 採多簽託管，讓借款人保有可在鏈上驗證的資產控制權
把這三家擺在一起看就會發現，合規壓力下，「你的幣到底在誰手上、能不能自己驗證」已經從技術細節，變成了市場上最實在的賣點。
CeFi 與 DeFi 在法律上分岔
同波監管風向，把加密借貸市場推向兩種活法。CeFi 這一側的借款人優先考慮資本保全，圖的是穩，不追高風險收益。DeFi 那一側則支援比特幣、以太坊與穩定幣抵押，資金隨著資金使用率與借款 APR 流動，替鏈上撐起整套交易活動。
值得注意的是市場的量體，目前消費級比特幣抵押借貸市場約 30 億美元，Ledn 先前的報告估算，這塊被低估的市場在未來十年有機會膨脹到 1 兆美元規模。換句話說這是還沒真正被打開的巨大市場，偏偏卡在監管重新畫邊界的時點上。
Peirce 這次倒也不是全然強硬。她同時喊話業者，與其假設區塊鏈能讓自己站在監管管不到的角落，不如在產品開發階段就主動找 SEC 談，並表示 SEC 願意考慮更新規則，在保護投資者、維持市場秩序的前提下替創新讓路。
常見問題
SEC 為什麼開始關注 DeFi 金庫與鏈上借貸協議？
SEC 委員 Hester Peirce 表示，把金融活動搬上區塊鏈不會自動豁免證券法。當借貸協議決定利率、抵押要求與清算門檻，或金庫由策展人挑選策略、再平衡資產時，可能構成投資顧問或投資公司，落入現有證券法規範。
監管趨嚴對比特幣抵押貸款市場有什麼影響？
合規壓力推動 CeFi 業者強化託管與資產隔離。Ledn 未償放款達 7.14 億美元並分離客戶抵押品，Strike 主打無清算風險貸款，Unchained 採多簽託管。長期持有者更傾向選擇可驗證、重視資本保全的託管服務。

title: Uniswap 攜手 Spark 開源 DualPool Hook 上線：做市閒置資金丟金庫生息，手續費、收益一魚兩吃
summary:
Uniswap Labs 與借貸協議 Spark 聯手打造的開源 Hook「DualPool」正式上線。它讓做 […]

〈Uniswap 攜手 Spark 開源 DualPool Hook 上線：做市閒置資金丟金庫生息，手續費、收益一魚兩吃〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Uniswap Labs 與借貸協議 Spark 聯手打造的開源 Hook「DualPool」正式上線。它讓做市商的資金在等待成交的空檔，先存進 ERC-4626 收益金庫生息，直到有人下單、價格觸及區間，才在同一筆交易裡把流動性拉回池內撮合，讓做市商同時賺到交易手續費與金庫收益。
（前情提要：Spark 聯手 Uniswap 推出穩定幣兌換基礎設施「FX Layer」，首波支援 USDS、USDT 與 PYUSD）
（背景補充：MakerDAO 推出借貸協議「Spark」，提供以 DAI、ETH 為中心之固定利率借款）
重點摘要
- Uniswap Labs 與 Spark 聯合開發的開源 Hook「DualPool」7 月完成稽核並正式上線，任何團隊都可部署
- DualPool 讓做市閒置資金存入 ERC-4626 收益金庫生息，交易觸價時才拉回撮合，LP 同賺手續費與金庫收益
- Spark 已遷移 1.5 億美元穩定幣（USDS、USDT、PYUSD）至 Uniswap v4，30 天撐起約 15 億美元交易量
做市商最頭痛的一件事，是資金放進流動性池裡等成交，但大多數時間根本沒人來交易，那些錢就這樣乾等、什麼都不做。Uniswap Labs 與借貸協議 Spark 聯手開發的開源 Hook「DualPool」正式上線，要解決的正是這個老問題。據 Uniswap 官方說明，DualPool 讓做市商的閒置資金先存進收益金庫賺利息，等真的有交易上門時，才把需要的流動性即時拉回池內撮合。
閒置資金這件事，DeFi 講了好幾年，DualPool 的解法不是想辦法消滅它，而是乾脆承認它躲不掉，讓它一邊閒著一邊賺錢。
閒置的錢也能生息
運作邏輯其實不難懂。做市商的資金平常放在 Spark 的 ERC-4626 收益金庫（一種標準化的收益型金庫）裡生息，只有當某筆交易的價格落進做市商設定的區間時，DualPool 才會在同一筆交易中，把剛好夠用的集中流動性從金庫抽出來完成撮合，接著在同一個區塊內把剩下的資金退回金庫繼續賺利息。
這代表流動性提供者（LP）一魚兩吃，同時收下交易手續費和金庫的利息收益。過去這兩件事在 DeFi 裡幾乎是互斥的，錢要嘛拿去做市、要嘛拿去借貸生息，很難兩邊都顧到，DualPool 把這道牆打掉了。
穩定幣兌換是主戰場
這套設計對穩定幣特別有用。穩定幣之間的匯價幾乎都貼在 1 美元附近，價格區間非常窄，也就是說任何時刻絕大多數的流動性都閒置在那裡，等一筆罕見的交易。過去這是純粹的浪費，現在這些錢至少能生息。
Spark 是 MakerDAO（現已更名 Sky）生態裡的借貸與儲蓄協議，早在 6 月就把 1.5 億鎂穩定幣流動性搬上 Uniswap v4，涵蓋 USDS、USDT 與 PYUSD，並以 USDS 作為報價基準資產。這批資金在 30 天內撐起約 15 億鎂的穩定幣交易量。
Spark 正在 Uniswap 上打造穩定幣基礎設施。他們剛把 1.5 億鎂流動性搬進協議，是 DeFi 史上規模最大的遷移之一。（Uniswap 官方說法）
Spark 把這視為「Stablecoin FX Layer（穩定幣兌換層）」的第一階段，目標是在 Uniswap v4 上建一個各家穩定幣共用的深水流動性池，接住 PayPal、Visa、Stripe 這些正在導入穩定幣的機構需求。當穩定幣的發行方越來越多，兌換碎片化就成了問題，一個共用的兌換底層要解的就是這件事。
開源之後，人人可部署
DualPool 現在完成稽核並開源，代表它不再是 Spark 專屬。任何團隊都能拿這個 Hook 去部署自己的池子，自訂價格區間、選擇單獨或池化存款，套用在穩定幣對，或是波動更大的資產對上。
當然，多接一層收益金庫，也等於多一層智能合約風險，稽核能降低疑慮，但從來不等於保證安全。Uniswap v4 的 Hook 機制上線以來，能真的跑出規模的實例並不多，DualPool 是其中之一。閒置資金到底能不能生息這件事，DeFi 喊了很多年，這次總算有人把 1.5 億鎂押上去實測。
常見問題
Uniswap 的 DualPool Hook 是什麼？
DualPool 是 Uniswap Labs 與 Spark 聯合開發的開源 Uniswap v4 Hook，讓做市商的閒置流動性先存進 ERC-4626 收益金庫生息，等交易觸及價格區間時才拉回池內撮合，使 LP 同時賺取交易手續費與金庫收益，7 月已完成稽核並開源。
Spark 為什麼把 1.5 億美元搬到 Uniswap v4？
Spark 要打造穩定幣兌換層（Stablecoin FX Layer），透過 DualPool 讓穩定幣的閒置流動性生息。6 月遷移的 1.5 億美元涵蓋 USDS、USDT、PYUSD，30 天內撐起約 15 億美元交易量，是 DeFi 史上規模最大的流動性遷移之一。

title: Kakao 聯手 Circle 鋪設韓元穩定幣支付網路，韓國法規落地前搶先卡位
summary:
Kakao 集團與 Circle 簽訂合作備忘錄，將 Circle 的 USDC 區塊鏈和全球支付基礎設施接入 […]

〈Kakao 聯手 Circle 鋪設韓元穩定幣支付網路，韓國法規落地前搶先卡位〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Kakao 集團與 Circle 簽訂合作備忘錄，將 Circle 的 USDC 區塊鏈和全球支付基礎設施接入 Kakao 的消費平台，涵蓋韓元穩定幣支付、跨境匯款和商家結算。韓國穩定幣立法仍在推進中，科技與金融巨頭已開始搶先部署。
（前情提要：Kakao集團宣布啟動穩定幣「對抗銀行聯盟」，鎖定支付、匯款、資本市場）
（背景補充：韓國最大金融集團 KB 完成韓元穩定幣支付驗證：透過 Kaia 跨境匯款壓縮至 3 分鐘、手續費省 87%）
韓國科技巨頭 Kakao 集團週四宣布與穩定幣發行商 Circle 簽署戰略合作備忘錄（MOU），雙方將探索以韓元錨定的穩定幣支付基礎設施，把 Circle 的區塊鏈與全球支付網路接入 Kakao 的消費平台和金融服務。
根據 Kakao 官方公告，Kakao、Kakao Pay 和 Kakao Bank 三家公司一同參與合作。涵蓋的領域包括穩定幣日常支付、跨境匯款、商家結算，以及傳統金融系統與區塊鏈網路的對接。雙方也考慮支援代幣化金融服務，但未公布具體產品或時間表。
韓國法規還沒落地，企業已搶先部署
這項合作突顯了韓國科技與金融平台的搶先卡位策略，在穩定幣立法完成前就開始布局。韓國政府正朝韓元穩定幣法制推進，政策制定者希望兼顧數位支付創新與儲備金、贖回和發行者監管等風險。
政府正在準備法案，涵蓋穩定幣發行、擔保品管理和內部控制等要求。立法者已提出多項競合提案，其中一項傾向用韓元錨定代幣降低對美元的依賴。
不過，法規程式因機構分歧而停滯。韓國央行主張銀行應保有穩定幣發行商的多數股權，金融委員會則警告資格限制可能壓縮競爭與創新空間。
韓國政府於 7 月 14 日公布經濟成長策略中，已將推動《數位資產基本法》列為 2026 下半年優先事項。
不只是 Kakao：韓國穩定幣競賽已全面展開
Kakao 並非唯一入局的企業。4 月，網路銀行 Kbank 與 Ripple 合作測試區塊鏈跨境匯款。5 月，KB 金融集團透過 Kaia 區塊鏈完成涵蓋穩定幣發行、離線商家支付和跨境匯款的驗證測試，並表示法規生效後即準備推出穩定幣服務。
Circle 方面也不閒著。4 月時，Circle 執行長曾明確表示不打算自行發行韓元穩定幣，但已為韓國市場準備好「發幣技術」基礎設施。這次與 Kakao 的合作，等同把技術授權給韓國最大的科技生態系之一。
從日本到韓國，Circle 的亞洲支付藍圖
Circle 最近也在日本展開類似的布局，與野村券商合作，目標在 2027 年讓日本企業用穩定幣進行跨境即時結算。加上這次與 Kakao 的合作，Circle 在亞洲的穩定幣支付網路正在成形。
對普通使用者來說，Kakao 的覆蓋面意味著一旦上線，韓國逾 2,000 萬 Kakao Pay 使用者和 Kakao Bank 客戶可以直接使用穩定幣進行日常交易，無需額外下載錢包或註冊新的金融帳戶。
韓國穩定幣的下一個里程碑，取決於立法何時跨過分歧、正式上路。但從企業端的動作來看，技術準備已經到位，剩下的只是時間問題。

title: 震撼幣圈！「永續合約鼻祖」BitMEX 宣告熄燈，結束 11 年傳奇霸業
summary:
發明「永續合約」、徹底顛覆加密貨幣市場版圖的衍生品交易所 BitMEX，於今（23）日拋出震撼彈，宣布將於 9 月 23 日終止營運，為長達 11 年的幣圈征途畫下休止符。

〈震撼幣圈！「永續合約鼻祖」BitMEX 宣告熄燈，結束 11 年傳奇霸業〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
發明「永續合約」、徹底顛覆加密貨幣市場版圖的衍生品交易所 BitMEX，於今（23）日拋出震撼彈，宣布將於 9 月 23 日終止營運，為長達 11 年的幣圈征途畫下休止符。
BitMEX 母公司 HDR Global Trading 周四向用戶發布公告指出：
我們懷著沉重的心情宣布，BitMEX 將於世界協調時間（UTC）2026 年 9 月 23 日凌晨 4 點正式終止營運。我們強烈建議所有用戶盡快平倉，並及早提領資產。
BitMEX 同時提醒，若用戶逾期未完成提領，平台將開始收取資產保管費，每月收費 50 美元，或按資產價值每年 1% 的比例計費。
BitMEX 表示，在母公司 HDR Global Trading Limited 完成策略檢討後，公司決定終止交易所業務，並已立即停止所有新帳戶註冊。
這家於 2014 年在塞席爾註冊成立、為現代數位資產衍生品交易奠定基礎的先驅平台，正式啟動了退場機制。為了確保市場有序關閉，系統將啟動風險縮減機制。雖然用戶未來數周仍可正常交易，但風險部位將逐步縮減，直至所有衍生品合約完成結算。
自 8 月 26 日起，BitMEX 將實施嚴格限制，全面禁止用戶建立新部位（建倉）；9 月 23 日正式停止營運前，平台將陸續強制平倉所有尚未結清的合約，確保市場有序退場。
BitMEX 的殞落早有跡可循。近年來，隨著市場流動性、做市商及大型投資人逐漸轉向流動性更深、交易品項更多、監管包袱較輕的中心化交易所，以及新興去中心化衍生品平台，BitMEX 的市場版圖已被競爭對手迅速蠶食。
回顧 2014 年，Arthur Hayes 、 Ben Delo 與 Samuel Reed 三人聯手創立這家交易所，為現代數位資產衍生品交易奠定基礎。在 2019 年牛市巔峰時期，BitMEX 更曾締造年交易量突破 1 兆美元的輝煌紀錄，橫掃全球近 57% 的加密貨幣衍生品市占率。 2018 年 7 月，BitMEX 單日交易量甚至飆破 80 億美元大關，創下單日周轉 100 萬枚比特幣的傲人歷史紀錄。
然而，輝煌背後卻暗藏監管危機。 2020 年，BitMEX 遭美國當局指控未落實反洗錢（AML）措施，BitMEX 隨後承認相關指控，三位共同創辦人也在美國提出刑事訴訟後相繼辭職。
展望後續退場作業，BitMEX 目前面臨的最大挑戰，是如何順利讓用戶將資產出金轉換為法定貨幣。考量到比特幣區塊鏈可能出現網路壅塞，提領時間恐遭大幅延宕。
不過，根據最新的儲備證明，BitMEX 平台資產仍足以全額覆蓋所有用戶存款。
歷經 11 年風雨，這家傳奇交易所即將走入歷史。值得一提的是，儘管多年來飽受各國監管機構的強力執法與打擊，BitMEX 至今仍保持著完美的資安紀錄，從未因駭客攻擊或智能合約漏洞而讓用戶損失過一毛錢。

title: 傳統金融殺入幣圈！韓國「未來資產」收購 Korbit 交易所，持股拚衝 97%
summary:
韓國「未來資產集團（Mirae Asset Financial Group）」正式完成對當地加密貨幣交易所 Korbit 的收購案，接下來更準備將持股比例從 92% 拉升至 97%，展現對數位資產市場的強烈企圖心。

〈傳統金融殺入幣圈！韓國「未來資產」收購 Korbit 交易所，持股拚衝 97%〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
韓國「未來資產集團（Mirae Asset Financial Group）」正式完成對當地加密貨幣交易所 Korbit 的收購案，接下來更準備將持股比例從 92% 拉升至 97%，展現對數位資產市場的強烈企圖心。
Korbit 於周四發布公告表示，未來資產顧問公司（Mirae Asset Consulting）在完成監管程序後，已取得 Korbit 的控股股權，成為該交易所的最大股東。
綜合 《韓國先驅報》、 《韓聯社》報導，未來資產集團已於周二提交更新版的監管文件，打算再斥資 532 萬美元增購 Korbit 股份，持股比例將從 92.06% 提高至 97.15% 。這筆追加的股權交易預計將於周五完成交割。
對於交易所既有用戶而言，Korbit 表示，本次股權變更不會影響任何平台服務，包括帳號登入、交易、法幣與加密貨幣存提款等功能皆將正常運作，不會因股權轉移而中斷。
Korbit 也強調，依據《虛擬資產用戶保護法》，用戶的資金、虛擬資產將持續與公司資產分開保管，個資處理方式也維持不變，用戶無須採取任何額外措施。
這樁收購案在韓國金融發展史上具有指標性意義。韓國反壟斷監管機構「公平交易委員會」（FTC）本月稍早放行此案時特別點出，這是韓國境內首宗「傳統金融集團關係企業收購加密貨幣交易所」的案例。
從市場版圖來看，Korbit 目前仍面臨激烈的競爭挑戰。根據 CoinGecko 統計，Korbit 在韓國加密貨幣交易所中名列第 4 位，過去 24 小時的交易量約落在 430 萬美元；相比之下，穩坐龍頭寶座的 Upbit，同期交易量則高達 2.24 億美元。

title: Friend of Manchester synagogue attacker jailed for plot on military base
summary: Mohammad Bashir, 31, drove Jihad Al-Shamie on a trip to conduct hostile reconnaissance at a military base.
full_text:
Friend of Manchester synagogue attacker jailed for plot on military base
- Published
A friend of the Manchester synagogue attacker has been jailed for life with a minimum of 17 years after the pair planned a separate attack on a military base.
Mohammad Bashir, 31, drove Jihad Al-Shamie on a 10-hour round trip to conduct hostile reconnaissance at the UK's Defence Academy in Shrivenham, Oxfordshire, on 14 August 2025.
Weeks after that journey, Al-Shamie, 35, was shot dead by police after carrying out the Heaton Park Synagogue attack, in which two Jewish men were killed.
Bashir was sentenced at Manchester Crown Court after pleading guilty to one count of preparing an act of terrorism.
'Espionage'
Counter terror police uncovered Bashir's friendship with Al-Shamie after reviewing his phones following the attack on the synagogue in October 2025.
The pair held extremist views and had discussed preparing for "war" and frequently made antisemitic remarks in WhatsApp conversations, Greater Manchester Police (GMP) said.
Bashir drove Al-Shamie to Shrivenham while Al-Shamie made notes about security arrangements at the base on his phone under the title "espionage".
They stopped at the site, which trains personnel from the British military and Civil Service as well as foreign students, for just 13 minutes and returned home the same day.
Both disposed of their phones after the trip, but officers accessed cloud data linked to their devices, and discovered Al-Shamie had searches using the terms 'weapons, potential target sites, and individuals with links to the Israeli military', GMP said.
CCTV of the pair discussing plans for an attack was also found by police.

title: UK millionaires ask Andy Burnham to tax them more
summary: Former footballer Gary Lineker and producer Brian Eno write to the new PM telling him "we can afford it".
full_text:
UK millionaires ask Andy Burnham to tax them more
- Published
Millionaires including former footballer Gary Lineker and music producer Brian Eno have written to new prime minister Andy Burnham asking to be taxed more.
In an open letter, 120 well-off Britons told Burnham: "We can afford it. We're not talking about higher taxes on those who get up and go to work for their income every day, but on the very richest whose income is derived from the wealth they hold."
Organised by Patriotic Millionaires, the letter said it would lead to a more equal society, and urged a "devolution of wealth and power from the very richest".
People can already give money or stocks voluntarily to the Treasury using its donation facility.
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said Lineker is "very welcome to pay more tax he can write a cheque to the treasury, no one is stopping him."
The group supports a 2% tax on wealth over £10m.
"Millionaires are a patriotic bunch," the letter states. "We love this country and we want it to succeed.
"But success requires investment and a primary source of untouched capital investment is sitting with us, in untaxed potential."
Other signatories include Richard Curtis, director of Notting Hill and Love Actually and Ian Gregg, the former managing director of Greggs and son of the bakery chain's founder.
The renewed call for higher tax on the wealthy follows a similar campaign in previous years.
Burnham did not rule out a wealth tax when asked about it by Lineker a few days before he became prime minister.
He suggested he may have "to ask for a little more" tax at some point.
The latest call from Patriotic Millionaires said there is a "need to embrace a new kind of devolution of wealth and power, from the very richest in order to reinvest back into our greatest asset in every region".
It added that in its own poll, the majority of millionaires wanted a higher tax on themselves.
"There are a few people left with outdated economic thinking and few others desperate to hold onto every penny they can... Those that can't see past the end of their own self interest have no place in designing a Britain for the future," the letter said.

title: 'Every victim will feel the same,' says mother of PC Harper over early prison release
summary: As the deadline for releases approaches, Andy Burnham has reignited a row over the legislation after he said he would review the plans.
full_text:
'Every victim will feel the same,' says mother of PC Harper over early prison release
- Published
The mother of PC Andrew Harper has said her son has not been given "proper justice" and "every victim will be feeling the same" about the early prison release scheme.
PC Harper, 28, was killed in 2019 when he was dragged by a car down a country road as three teenagers fled the scene of a quad bike theft in Berkshire.
Under the Sentencing Act, which is due to be implemented in September, two of the men involved could be freed early.
As the deadline for releases approaches, Andy Burnham has reignited a row over the legislation after he said he would review the plans.
But, two prison staffers told the BBC that governors were told to stop work on the implementation of the Sentencing Act two weeks ago. The government maintains there has been no decision to delay its introduction.
PC Harper's mother, Debbie Adlam, said the release of Jessie Cole and Albert Bowers - two of the passengers in the getaway car which killed Harper - was "sprung" on her family.
Cole and Bowers - who were 17 at the time - were sentenced to 13 years in custody for manslaughter but could be released after six years under the act.
The driver of the car, Henry Long - who was 18 - was jailed for 16 years for manslaughter but would not be eligible for early release.
"It just feels like another let down for Andrew really, when you look at the horrific way he was killed, we have to live with that," she told BBC Radio 4's Today Programme.
"The feeling that Andrew hasn't been given proper justice, it is very personal obviously... every victim will be feeling the same."
The Sentencing Act is the government's attempt to find a permanent, more sustainable solution to a prison overcrowding crisis after an emergency scheme was introduced by the Labour government in 2024.
Tens of thousands of inmates have already been let out of prison early under those measures.
Unlike the 2024 plan, the new act includes no exemptions for prisoners convicted of serious crimes, domestic abuse or terrorism.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday he could not commit to changing the policy completely but would "look at it in detail before we go further forward".
He also acknowledged there was "pressure on prison places" and a failure to invest in the system created "an unacceptable situation".
Adlam said her message to Burnham was to "look at the big picture for the country".
"As a country you cannot have a justice system that works that way, just because it's full doesn't mean it's good enough to let people go, you need to find ways and I'd like to know what's being considered".
"I think the justice system has been lacking for quite some time and it needs a proper overhaul really."
Asked if the scheme will go ahead, Chief Secretary to the Treasury Emma Reynolds told the BBC: "That is something that he [Burnham] and the Justice Secretary will set out in the coming weeks."
"We do have to bear in mind, which I know is cold comfort to the victims, in 2024 when we took office, we inherited a system... that was on the brink of collapse, with fewer than 100 prison places available".
But Domestic Abuse Commissioner Dame Nicole Jacobs said the mitigations promised for victims ahead of the act coming in have not been implemented.
"For many victims who don't have that length of sentence for their offender, they won't know who to turn to, who to call," she told BBC Breakfast.
"When they receive these letters they'll have questions, concerns, very importantly things they may want to feed back to probation.
"We were promised, I was promised, by government, a helpline that would be stood up for those kinds of things, so that risk management and the communication and the helpline are not in place for September."

title: Thousands evacuated in France fires
summary: A third firefighter has died in Europe while tackling ongoing wildfires across the continent.
full_text:
Thousands evacuated in France fires
- Published
Around 12,000 people have been evacuated from the south-west of France as the country battles ongoing wildfires days after two firefighters died near Bordeaux airport, French media reported.
The Gironde region government said more than 2,000 hectares (4,000 acres) of land have been destroyed.
The use of internal combustion and electric engines have been banned in predominantly forested areas, and a number of roads have been closed. No injuries have been reported on Thursday.
Meanwhile in Italy, authorities have paid tribute to a firefighter who died tackling a wildfire in San Cataldo, as Sicily President Renato Schifani wished a "speedy recovery" to another involved in the same operation.
Italian Interior Minister Matteo Piantedosi paid tribute to late firefighter Alessandro Marchi who he said died "in service to the community".
"He will not be forgotten," he said in a post on X.
In an update on Wednesday, head of the Sicilian Civil Protection Salvo Cocina said there had been more than 350 fires on the island including ten major ones which led to precautionary evacuations.
He said the fires had human causes - adding that firefighting has become a social and public order problem.
Meanwhile, in France, the AFP news agency reported that 10,000 tourists were among those evacuated.
France has been paying tribute to the two firefighters who died earlier in the week. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez posted photos from an event that took place on Wednesday - the day after their deaths were announced.
He said the moment was filled with "immense emotion" as he expressed "infinite gratitude" and "unwavering support" to their families.
The Gironde region remains under a red alert, with some leisure sites in exposed forest areas to be closed on Thursday afternoon and evening.
Yassmina de Freitas, 19, who lives in the coastal town of Le Porge, said she noticed smoke and the smell of burning at lunchtime on Wednesday.
By the afternoon "ash… [and] half-burned tree bark" were falling, the sky was "very dark" and the smoke was getting "thicker and thicker".
At around 20:00 local time (19:00 BST), her family was evacuated by law enforcement and taken to a gymnasium in a neighbouring town. They had to leave two of their cats and four chickens behind as they could not be found in the flurry to leave.
She said she could not sleep at all and was waking up every hour to check the fire's progress.
"I could see the number of hectares burned rising steadily," she said.
Further evacuations took place on Thursday morning on the Lège-Cap-Ferret peninsula, south of Le Porge.
In the Var region in south-east France, evacuated residents were told they could go home to assess potential damage to properties on Thursday morning. However, local authorities said they should be prepared to evacuate again if needed.
Areas in this region are under a "very high" warning for forest fires from Forecaster Météo-France.
Several French departments have recently been ravaged by wildfires during a series of unusual and prolonged heatwaves that have swept across Europe this summer.
Madrid has also been impacted by fires, but overnight most evacuated residents were told they can return to their homes - with the exception of one area in Villa del Prado.
A fire nearby is still burning, and almost 90 personnel and a helicopter have been deployed to get the flames under control.
Emergency services said they had carried out a "direct attack" on the fire and shared a video on social media showing emergency service workers approaching the flames with hoses.
Local authorities continued to warn of an "extreme risk of fires" on Thursday morning.
Spain's weather service AEMET said temperatures of up to 36C are forecast on Thursday afternoon.
Countries across Europe have seen record temperatures in recent months.
A report released in April by the Copernicus Climate Change Service found at least 95% of Europe saw "above average" annual temperatures in 2025 and identified Europe as the fastest-warming continent.
Wildfire-burnt area and fire emissions both reached record levels last year, the report said.

title: Is 2026 the Commonwealth Games' last dance or a future-proofing revamp?
summary: It's been going for 96 years - but many doubted the 2026 Commonwealth Games, which open in Glasgow on Thursday, would happen. So what could the future hold for the event?
full_text:
Is 2026 the Commonwealth Games' last dance or a future-proofing revamp?
- Published
It is an event that has been going for 96 years.
The Commonwealth Games have provided iconic sporting moments – from Roger Bannister's win in the 'Miracle Mile' of 1954 and Eilish McColgan breaking her mum's record in 2022 to England's netball victory four years earlier in Australia.
But the 2026 Games, which open in Glasgow on Thursday, come at an intriguing time for the event. Many doubted whether they would even happen - and when they do go ahead, they will do so in a stripped-back form.
So how did we get here? And do athletes and fans still care and what could the future hold?
At risk or future-proofed?
The 2026 Commonwealth Games were thrown into doubt when its original hosts, the Australian state of Victoria, pulled out in 2023 citing spiraling costs. That decision took even the leaders of Commonwealth Sport by surprise.
After more than a year of uncertainty, Glasgow stepped in to host the Games for the second time, following on from the highly successful event in the Scottish city in 2014.
But, with limited preparation time a significant factor, the Games' return to Glasgow a much smaller event.
There was competition across 18 sports in 2014 – a number that rose to 20 for Birmingham 2022 - but only 10 sports will feature this year.
There are expected to be around 2,000 fewer athletes and no new stadiums have been built, with the athletics events having moved from the 46,000-seater Hampden Park to the Scotstoun Stadium, which will hold just over 10,000 people.
Costs of running the event have been cut from between £700m and £800m for Birmingham 2022 and the Gold Coast Games in 2018 to £160m for Glasgow.
Whether by accident or design, organisers insist the situation has created a template for the future.
They believe a smaller, cheaper, more sustainable Commonwealth Games can last.
"I don't think we have ever been stronger," Katie Sadleir, chief executive of Commonwealth Sport, told BBC Sport.
"We took a hard look at ourselves and realised we needed to reset and reimagine this Games so it is an attractive proposition for our members."
Crucially, the Commonwealth Games have already secured the Indian city of Ahmedabad as host for 2030, when the number of sports is expected rise to between 15 and 18.
Several countries have also expressed interest in hosting in 2034. New Zealand has done so publicly while Nigeria remains interested after challenging Ahmedabad's bid for 2030.
- Is Glasgow ready for the Commonwealth Games - and does the city care? - Published6 days ago
 
- All you need to know about Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games - Published6 July
 
Do athletes still care?
Having begun in 1930 as the British Empire Games, the Commonwealth Games face questions about their place and relevance in the modern world.
England weightlifter Emily Campbell told the BBC the Games are "one of the best things that came out of colonisation" while three-time Olympic swimming gold medallist Tom Dean insists they can be a "force for good" despite the difficult past.
"It is even more reason to push the Commonwealths into the spotlight because it shows the best side of sport," he told BBC Sport.
However, the Glasgow edition has been hit by the absence of star names.
Injuries, such as those to Olympic gold-medal winning gymnast Max Whitlock and Australia's Olympic backstroke champion Kaylee McKeown, are unavoidable and unfortunate.
But other athletes have opted to prioritise different events.
Olympic 800m champion Keely Hodgkinson is skipping Glasgow in favour of the European Athletics Championships, which start in Birmingham on 10 August and are arguably the bigger track and field event this summer.
Dina Asher-Smith, the fastest British woman in history, and Olympic 100m champion Julien Alfred of St Lucia have also pulled out. Canadian swimming superstar Summer McIntosh is another notable absentee.
But it is not all doom and gloom.
Josh Kerr, fresh from breaking the mile world record, will return to home soil to race for Scotland, as will McColgan.
Katerina Johnson-Thompson is chasing her third Commonwealth heptathlon title in a row and Adam Ramsay-Peaty returns to the same pool in which he won two golds in 2014.
The Commonwealth Games remain a pinnacle for sports like netball and there is also an increased focus on Para-sport, with this the most integrated Games ever.
Six of the 10 sports include Para-competitions with a Commonwealth Games record 47 medal events. Golds, silvers and bronzes won in Para-events will, unlike with other multi-sport events, count towards the overall medal total.
"There are not many opportunities for the integration of multi-sports [events]," Paralympic swimming champion Brock Whiston told BBC Sport.
"Without the Commonwealth Games, the smaller countries don't get the chance to show how powerful that integration is.
"The Commonwealth Games is vital to ensuring there are equal opportunities."
English swimmer James Guy, another Olympic champion who will be at his fourth Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, told BBC Sport the event remains a crucial part of an athlete's development.
"It is a bit easier to make than the GB team," he said.
"It is a really good way to get on there, get on a relay and get a medal and that is really important for development so the younger guys and girls can progress."
- Five big names to look out for at Glasgow 2026 - Published1 day ago
 
What about the fans?
As ever, another major factor in assessing the potential longevity of the Commonwealth Games will be the response from fans.
Around 1.3 million tickets were sold in 2014 – a figure that will certainly not be matched this time.
Sales have been strongest for athletics and cycling but tickets remain available for all sports across the 11 days of competition.
There is also a significant change in the UK this year with the BBC, who had provided coverage for 18 Commonwealth Games in a row, being replaced by TNT Sports as the live television broadcaster. The Games are also available to watch on streaming service HBO Max.
While radio coverage remains on BBC Radio 5 Live, it means there will be no free-to-air live TV coverage.
That makes cutting through to the general public more challenging at a crucial time.
The next 11 days remain significant for the Games' future.

title: Andy Burnham's plan to collaborate with social media creators
summary: The new prime minister plans to work with influencers and social media creators to get his message out.
full_text:
Andy Burnham's plan to collaborate with social media creators
- Published
Andy Burnham is a past master at using social media to create a political brand - and it seems he has no plans to let up now that he is prime minister.
One Downing Street source told the BBC they planned to take a "more social first" and "authentic to Andy" approach, with "less high production, polished" content than might have been seen from a prime minister in the past.
This means we can expect more clips of Burnham in casual mode, chatting into a handheld phone or answering questions on policy in an apparently spontaneous fashion on X, Instagram or TikTok.
There will also be a focus on collaborations with social media creators.
In an earlier age, political leaders liked to court TV stars and other celebrities to help get their message out.
Now the Holy Grail is online influencers, who are seen as more authentic, and trusted, by hard-to-reach voters who don't watch much TV or read newspapers.
Sir Keir Starmer's government had already begun experimenting with giving access to influencers, with ministers appearing on some of the more popular channels.
Downing Street also held receptions for influencers and during Tim Allan's tenure as director of communications content creators were invited to Downing Street press conferences.
Some critics saw this is a way of avoiding serious scrutiny of polices in favour of softball questions from non-specialists.
But Burnham's advisers see collaborations with influencers as a way of getting the government's message to audiences it might not normally reach.
A Downing Street source said "the vast majority" of the public will not see or interact with content that is coming from government or the prime minister's social media channels.
In the hours before and after becoming prime minister, Burnham co-authored two posts on TikTok and Instagram, including a running video with Sir Mo Farah.
Young TikTokers were also invited to Downing Street to thank them for their work on his Makerfield by-election campaign.
One of the social channels Sir Keir Starmer appeared on was run by Ukrainian online personality Max Klymenko, who won TikTok Creator of the year for his viral "The Career Ladder" series, where he quizzes people about their job history.
Klymenko was first approached by Burnham's team around two months ago to collaborate on content.
His team filmed the video quizzing the former Greater Manchester mayor on his first job, before he entered politics, a week ago, then planned to post it on his first day as prime minister to capitalise on the buzz.
The creator's core audience are aged 18 to 24, according to his team, while the majority of people who watch his content are aged between 25 and 30.
A member of his team pointed out this is far younger than the audience for a traditional TV interview, while his cumulative subscriber and follower count across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook is more than 16.3 million accounts.
While there is some paid-for content on his pages, Klymenko said no payment or contract was exchanged with Burnham's team and they did not request changes to the content before it was posted.
Meanwhile, Sir Mo Farah's uploads, running while discussing sport, education and mental health with Burnham, went to his three million followers across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, a far bigger reach than the prime minister's personal channels.
Andy Burnham Went Online, and Got Into No 10
Ros Atkins reports on how the new PM uses social media to get his message across.
Available now
The strategy is the brainchild of Abby Tomlinson, who ran Burnham's digital communications during the by-election, and who the BBC can confirm has been kept on for a new role in Burnham's administration.
She began her career in social media aged 17 by starting a "Milifandom" campaign on social media for Ed Miliband over a decade ago.
In more recent years, she has worked in digital communications for the Labour Party, and for Keir Starmer in Number10 before quitting last year.
Tomlinson has been credited with how Burnham connected with voters across platforms in recent months.
The new PM has rationed interviews with traditional media since returning to Parliament, in favour of vlogs, a question and answer session on Reddit and X posts clapping back at political opponents.
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch took to Reddit to urge him to "come out from hiding, face a proper press conference and submit yourself to scrutiny and some tough questions".
Burnham responded to it by saying it had only been two weeks since he faced questions from "74,000 members of the public of Makerfield".
Another key strand of Burnham's campaigning strategy has been connecting with and organising grassroots social media activists.
Among the politicians and staffers invited to stand outside Number 10 to watch Burnham become prime minister on Monday were teenage TikTokers whose video edits have brought him to a new social media audience.
Between them, Will, Lottie, Megan, Ellen and Poppy, all aged between 17 and 19 have racked up millions of likes on TikTok, and across platforms share memes, trends and nostalgic edits of New Labour footage, including of Burnham's time in office.
The Labour activists were invited to canvass with him and make edits of his time on the Makerfield by-election campaign trail in a language and style that resonates with people online.
One way they got thousands of likes was by getting him to sign and pose with red pre-made cocktails popular with Gen Z.
Megan Cassidy, 19, from Havering, started making Labour content a year ago and said it was "surreal" to have found herself at Downing Street: "I really felt like I was witnessing history around me".
The young Labour activists said they were given access to Burnham and footage of him by his team, but are not paid and can choose to edit the material how they like.
They saw it as an opportunity to gain ground from social media savvy parties like Reform, whose leader Nigel Farage has an exponentially bigger following on social media, and the Greens who have experienced large growth in recent months.
It helped that Burnham was "natural" and happy to spontaneously appear in content, they told the BBC.
"I do think he gets it, absolutely compared to other politicians, compared to Starmer for example, I think he's a lot more charismatic," said Megan.

title: Seinfeld actor apologises to reality star for 'inappropriate' sketch when she was 17
summary: Jason Alexander said he "truly regrets" the Funny Or Die sketch he appeared in with Courtney Stodden.
full_text:
Seinfeld actor apologises to reality star for 'inappropriate' sketch when she was 17
- Published
US actor Jason Alexander has apologised to reality star Courtney Stodden for an "inappropriate" comedy sketch they appeared in together when she was 17.
The Seinfeld star appeared in a Funny or Die sketch with Stodden in 2012, which parodied daytime talk shows such as Dr Phil.
The sketch saw Alexander rubbing a mobile phone on Stodden's breasts because it was the only area with "plenty of signal".
After Stodden reposted and questioned the clip earlier this week, Alexander said he was "deeply sorry" and offered her his "sincerest apologies".
Writing on Instagram,, external Stodden said: "The older I get, the more impossible this is to understand.
"During this comedy sketch, Jason Alexander repeatedly rubbed his phone across my breasts while saying there was 'no signal' in my head but 'plenty of signal' in my chest.
"Later in the sketch, he joked that when I turned 18 he'd like to take me behind the couch and 'have his way' with me."
Stodden noted that Alexander was credited as one of the writers of the episode, adding: "Looking back now, I don't see comedy. I see a 17-year-old girl whose body became part of an adult joke.
"I was a minor. I didn't have the legal power to decide whether I wanted to participate... I was the only child in the room. I felt so alone."
Stodden said she chose to speak out after reflecting: "I can't change what happened to me but I can ask myself: How did so many adults look at a minor and decide this was acceptable?"
In a statement issued to US publications including Variety, Alexander said: "Looking back at the comedy sketch in which Ms Stodden and I participated in 2012, I completely agree that it was inappropriate and I truly regret it.
"But more importantly, I am deeply sorry for any harm or distress it has caused Ms Stodden. I offer her my sincerest apologies."
Stodden, 31, is currently campaigning for California to pass a bill that would ban child marriage by making the legal minimum age 18 years old.
Stodden married 51-year-old actor Doug Hutchison in 2011, when she was 16 years old.
The marriage was legal because her parents gave permission. Stodden and Hutchison divorced in 2020.
Marrying aged 16 or 17 remains legal in 33 US states with parental consent or a judicial waiver. It was legal in every state until 2018.
Stodden told the Hollywood Reporter she "appreciated" Alexander's apology.
"People keep asking if he's apologised privately, and he hasn't," she continued. "A private apology would be meaningful, but meaningful action would be even more powerful.
"If he truly regrets what happened, I'd invite him to support [campaign group] Unchained At Last and the fight to end child marriage through AB 1267. That's how we turn accountability into lasting change."
Alexander played George Costanza in Seinfeld and also appeared in ER, Pretty Woman and Shallow Hal.
Stodden has appeared on reality shows including Couples Therapy, Celebrity Big Brother, Reality Ex-Wives and Celebs Go Dating.

title: Former River City actor Iain Robertson jailed for nine years for rape
summary: The 45-year-old, played Stevie O'Hara in the BBC soap, was convicted of five offences against the women between 2004 and 2019.
full_text:
Former River City actor Iain Robertson jailed for nine years for rape
- Published
Former River City actor Iain Robertson has been jailed for nine years for raping a woman and assaulting two others.
The 45-year-old, who played Stevie O'Hara in the BBC soap, was convicted of five offences, including domestic abuse, against the women between 2004 and 2019.
During his trial at the High Court in Glasgow, Robertson was referred to by witnesses as "violent" and "controlling".
Lady Drummond told Robertson, who appeared via video link from Barlinnie prison, that his behaviour had a "long lasting and life-changing" impact on his victims.
The judge said they now suffered from anxiety, fear and flashbacks and had problems with trust and a sense of safety.
The trial heard how Robertson, of Carbeth in Stirlingshire, raped a woman on one occasion between 2018 and 2019 as well as a separate sex assault.
The pair came to know each other from working together on River City.
The woman said she did not want anything sexual to happen, but believed Robertson did.
The relationship became intimate, but the woman later told Robertson she wanted their relationship to go back to being platonic.
She said one evening she was at his home in Glasgow's Tradeston and planned to sleep on the sofa, but Robertson allegedly told her she could join him in bed as "nothing would happen".
However, the witness said that the actor instead "had sex" with her.
She did not say anything to Robertson at the time, but said she did not participate in what happened and she did not want it to happen.
She also described an earlier incident when Robertson carried out a sex act on her and she "just waited for it to be over".
He was also found guilty of engaging in a course of abusive behaviour against her.
Prosecutors presented evidence of another sexual incident involving a second woman to corroborate the rape charge.
Robertson was accused of forced himself on the woman during in the Lake District in September 2007.
Jurors did not have to deliver a verdict on this, but he was convicted of assault by pouring wine over her head and her university course work.
The court heard that Robertson was also violent with a third female - a fellow actor.
The woman described how Robertson hounded her with an "obsessive" amount of calls and voicemails, and sent gifts to theatres where she was performing.
He was found guilty of threatening and abusive behaviour towards her.
Lasting damage
The Crown Office and Procurator Fiscal Service praised the women who spoke out against Robertson.
"It is through their testimony that Robertson was brought to justice," said Procurator Fiscal Faye Cook.
"Robertson held a high-profile position through his career but in private he assaulted and abused females who trusted him.
"This has caused lasting damage to the lives of people who thought they were safe around him."
Robertson was put on the sex offenders' register and will be supervised for a further three years upon his release from jail.
A spokesperson for the BBC said: "We are appalled by these crimes and our thoughts are with the victims in this case."

title: Animal lover run over by own car while saving cat on hill
summary: Jacqueline Davies was able to dial 999 after the incident, but died in hospital the following day.
full_text:
Animal lover run over by own car while saving cat on hill
- Published
An animal lover was run over and killed by her own car after she got out to save a cat as the handbrake failed on a slope, an inquest has heard.
Jacqueline Davies, 75, climbed out of the driving seat of her red Ford Fiesta to move the cat to safety on 6 July while on a hill, but her car rolled forward and fatally struck her.
Gwent Coroner's Court heard Davies, from Hollybush in Cwmbran, Torfaen, was able to dial 999 after the incident, but died in hospital.
In a statement, Davies' family said she had a "strength that inspired those around her" and added they were "desperate for answers".
The inquest heard Davies was taken to University Hospital of Wales in Cardiff with serious injuries, and died the following day.
Coroner Rose Farmer said her provisional cause of death was given as a major haemorrhage, injury to the inferior vena cava - the largest vein in the body - and trauma.
Her family said: "We are heartbroken beyond words at the sudden loss of our beloved mum.
"She was a strong, independent, spirited mum who was never scared to speak her mind, and that was one of the many things we loved about her.
"She was honest, determined and full of character, with a strength that inspired those around her.
"Our family is devastated and life will never be the same without her.
"We are trying to come to terms with what has happened but we are also desperate for answers."
Gwent Police wants anyone travelling in the area of Bryn Millwr, Hollybush, on 6 July between 10:00 BST and 10:30 who may have witnessed the crash to contact officers.
The inquest into Davies' death will resume on 13 April 2027.

title: No men's Ashes Test in north of England - full 2027 schedule
summary: Neither Old Trafford nor Headingley will host a men's Ashes Test between England and Australia next summer.
full_text:
No 2027 men's Ashes Test in north of England
- Published
England will begin their quest to regain the men's Ashes from Australia at Trent Bridge on 18 June next year, with the women's series starting six days later.
The second men's Test at Lord's begins on 30 June and the third at Edgbaston on 8 July.
The Utilita Bowl in Southampton will become the 10th UK ground to host a men's Ashes Test when the fourth Test gets under way on 21 July, with the series concluding at the Kia Oval from 29 July.
The multi-format Women's Ashes will be held from 24 June to 20 July as the two series run alongside each other like in 2023.
The men will not play any Tests in the north of England after Emirates Old Trafford and Headingley were not selected to host matches.
The decision was criticised by the now prime minister Andy Burnham - then the mayor of Greater Manchester - when it was announced in 2023.
England, who lost 4-1 in Australia last winter and are without a Test coach after the sacking of Brendon McCullum, will prepare for the Ashes by facing Bangladesh in a one-off Test at Lord's starting on 28 May.
Australia will play a warm-up game against England Lions at Old Trafford from 7-10 June as part of a new reciprocal agreement between the countries to arrange a "high-quality opposition at an international venue".
England women, who lost 16-0 in Australia in 2025, will look to win their first Ashes Test since 2014 when the series starts with a four-day game at Headingley from 24 June.
The sides will also play three T20s starting on 3 July - at Trent Bridge, The Oval and Old Trafford - and three one-day internationals beginning on 13 July, at Southampton, Lord's and Edgbaston.
In the multi-format series, victory in the Test is worth four points and each win in a white-ball game is worth two.
BBC Test Match Special will have ball-by-ball coverage on both Ashes series, while the BBC Sport website and app will feature in-play video clips of all the key moments. Highlights will also be available on BBC TV and iPlayer.
The England and Wales Cricket Board announced on Wednesday that a England men's mixed disability team will face Australia next summer, although a schedule has not been confirmed.
England men's summer in 2027 will begin with a five-match ODI series against Pakistan in May, before finishing with three T20s and five ODIs against New Zealand in September as they prepare for 50-over World Cup starting in October.
England women will host Bangladesh in a three-match T20 series and a three-match ODI series in September.
The men's World Test Championship final will take place at The Oval from 9 June.
Australia's warm-up game against England Lions will be reviewed if the tourists reach the final.
The Ashes will complete a marathon red-ball run for Australia, who host Bangladesh for two Tests in August, tour South Africa for three Tests in October, host New Zealand for four Tests at the turn of the year, compete in five Tests in India in January and February and stage a one-off Test against England in March to mark 150 years of Test cricket.
Old Trafford, which was due to host a Test in 2027 - as per the venue allocation made in 2023, external - will host an ODI against Pakistan.

title: Iran, Houthis strike tankers as US bombing continues: What’s the latest?
summary: With the Houthi naval blockade, shipping disruptions now impact the Bab al-Mandeb strait in addition to Hormuz.
full_text:
Iran, Houthis strike tankers as US bombing continues: What’s the latest?
With the Houthi naval blockade, shipping disruptions now impact the Bab al-Mandeb strait in addition to Hormuz.
The United States continued to hit Iran for a 12th consecutive night early on Thursday, and Iran retaliated, striking targets across the Gulf, particularly in Kuwait and Jordan.
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Thursday that an explosion set a tanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz after it attempted to navigate the southern route off the coast of Oman.
Here is a recap of what happened on Wednesday night and Thursday.
Where did the US attack Iran?
US Central Command (CENTCOM) said at 02:30 GMT on Thursday that it concluded the latest round of strikes against Iran.
It targeted Iranian military targets, including maritime capabilities, missile and drone storage facilities, coastal surveillance sites and air defence assets, CENTCOM said, without specifying what areas in Iran were struck.
A local official told the Mehr news agency that US missiles struck the area around a passenger terminal in Shalamcheh, a western city near the Iraqi border. Two people were killed in the attack, the deputy governor of Iran’s Khuzestan province told the state broadcaster IRIB on Thursday. Local media also reported that 11 people were injured.
Al Jazeera’s Tohid Assidi reported from Iranian capital Tehran that overnight strikes targeted at least three cities in the southwestern province of Khuzestan. This included the city of Ramshir, where an asphalt facility was reported to have been targeted.
In Hormozgan province, explosions were heard in the city of Sirik, which overlooks the Strait of Hormuz, Assidi reported.
He added that the governor confirmed an overnight attack in Bushehr on a power substation near the city’s nuclear power plant. This resulted in a few hours of power outage in the city.
IRIB also reported that explosions were heard in Iran’s Jask.
The Tasnim news agency reported that a US missile hit a location on the outskirts of the city of Andimeshk.
Two naval search and rescue vessels were hit and seriously damaged in a US attack on Iran’s Hormozgan, the ISNA news agency reported, citing the province’s Ports and Maritime Administration.
Where did Iran hit back?
Kuwait
The IRGC claimed attacks on US assets in Kuwait on Thursday.
It said it had “attacked and destroyed a large warehouse of military equipment, a Patriot missile defence system, and a hangar of American MQ9 drones” at Ali Al Salem airbase.
Addressing the Kuwaiti people, the IRGC insisted that it was the US, not Iran, that had “violated your territorial integrity and sovereignty”.
It said its attacks were aimed at US bases, territory it described as beyond the control of Kuwait’s own border guards.
“So it is America that has violated your territorial integrity and sovereignty, not us. We are attacking lands occupied by the American army, an army that knows nothing but crime,” the IRGC said.
Jordan
Later on Thursday, the IRGC claimed attacks on US assets in Jordan, saying it had “destroyed a radar of the American THAAD missile defence system with lightning strikes”.
“A Patriot system and a C-RAM radar were also targeted and destroyed, and the fuel tanks of the American base were set on fire,” it said.
The IRGC added that “a large helicopter equipment warehouse and a helicopter repair and maintenance shed were also set on fire and destroyed”.
Addressing the Jordanian people, it insisted that its actions did not violate Jordanian sovereignty, arguing that the US military presence infringes on local authority and that targeting US forces was a legal and necessary response.
What happened in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea?
The IRGC said an explosion set a tanker on fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
In a statement carried by Iranian media, it said two other vessels quickly turned back following the explosion.
The IRGC claimed the three ships were acting under US orders and had “intended to pass through the mine-laid route south of the Strait of Hormuz”.
“The powerful IRGC Navy emphasises that the Strait of Hormuz is under our control and that as long as America’s evil deeds in the region continue, it is completely closed and no oil tanker will enter or exit [the strait],” it warned.
“Any ship that is deceived by America and intends to pass through without coordination with the Islamic Republic of Iran will suffer the same fate.”
The UK Maritime Trade Operations Centre said a ship was targeted 70 nautical miles (130km) off the Saudi coast, causing a fire on board. There was no mention of casualties among the crew.
The Houthis, meanwhile, claimed a major operation against two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, called the Encelia and the Layla. The Saudi SPA news agency confirmed the Encelia was hit.
The Houthis said they targeted those two tankers with cruise and ballistic missiles as well as drones, causing huge balls of fire and devastation.
The Houthis framed the attack as part of a tit-for-tat campaign against Saudi Arabia. They are calling it a “siege-for-siege”. They said it has been 12 years since Saudi Arabia has been imposing a siege on the Yemeni people, and that it is now time for Yemen and the Houthis to respond in kind. Riyadh has rejected Houthi claims that it had besieged Yemen.
