title: Google closes in on another billion- user product with Gemini
summary: Gemini had over 750 million monthly users in February.
full_text:
Google is about to add another name to its long list of products with more than a billion users, a list that already includes Search, Gmail, Drive, Android, YouTube, and Chrome. The company said during its Q2 2026 call that the AI assistant Gemini now has over 950 million monthly users.
The company noted that Gemini users have tripled from last year. Earlier in February, it said that the Gemini app crossed 750 million monthly active users. With this growth, Google’s assistant is in line to compete more closely with OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which hit 1 billion monthly active users in June.
“Users love new agentic features like Daily Brief and our personalized agent, Gemini Spark, which is now available in the U.S. and internationally. We’ve been shipping helpful new features like this at an incredible pace,” Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai said during the call.
Apart from users on Android, the Gemini app has found a strong user base on iOS with launches like the Nano Banana image generation model. According to AppFigures, the app has been downloaded over 137 million times on iOS in the last 12 months.
In its latest “State of AI” report, the analytics firm Sensor Tower noted that ChatGPT’s market share among AI assistants fell below 50% for the first time. The report, which looked at H1 2026, also noted that Gemini’s share rose to 27.7%.
Many people already use AI assistant apps as a substitute for search. However, Google reported that its search vertical is going strong, partially thanks to the AI-centric overhaul. During this quarter, its Q&A-style AI mode crossed 1 billion users. The company said that it is driving “an incremental increase” in search queries. Google also noted that through hardware engineering, it has reduced the cost of AI mode for the company, despite introducing new models and features.

title: Amazon is bringing games to Prime Video
summary: Amazon is hoping the addition of games can turn Prime Video into a one-stop entertainment destination, borrowing a strategy from Netflix, which has increasingly embraced party games over the past several years.
full_text:
Amazon announced on Thursday that it’s bringing games to Prime Video by integrating its Luna cloud gaming service into the streaming platform. Games including “Hogwarts Legacy,” “EA Sports FC 26,” “Indiana Jones and the Great Circle,” “Clue,” and “Taboo” will be available starting today on Fire TVs in the U.S. and U.K.
With this move, Amazon is hoping games can turn Prime Video into a one-stop entertainment destination, borrowing a strategy from Netflix, which has increasingly embraced party games over the past several years. Since Amazon already operates a gaming service, it makes sense for the tech giant to integrate it into its streaming platform.
Alongside third-party titles and cult classics like “Taboo,” the games library will also feature titles developed by Amazon’s own gaming division, including its “Courtroom Chaos” games and the co-op card battler “Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite.”
Until now, games on Luna were only accessible through the cloud gaming platform’s standalone app available to Prime members. Now, they’ll be available alongside Prime Video’s movies and TV shows.
Amazon says its vision is to remove the barriers to gaming and make it accessible to anyone regardless of their experience or budget. The tech giant says Luna is designed to bring gaming to a much broader audience by removing the need for expensive consoles or gaming PCs and making games as easy to access as movies or TV shows.
Prime members can now access the new “Games” tab on Prime Video and start playing on their TV using a controller or their phone.
“For a lot of people, games have been harder to find than they should be,” Jeff Gattis, general manager of gaming at Amazon, said in a press release. “Bringing Luna inside Prime Video allows Prime members to discover games more naturally, and if they see one they like, they click it and they’re in. That’s less time searching and more time playing great games included with their Prime membership.”
Amazon says it will add new games every month. The tech giant also plans to bring games to additional devices and countries in the coming months.

title: MeBeMe’s new ‘interrupter’ app helps you become your best self instead of doomscrolling
summary: MeBeMe delivers small tasks to help users become their best selves instead of endlessly scrolling.
full_text:
MeBeMe is a new app that acts as an “interrupter,” designed to help users become their best selves instead of getting lost in endless scrolling. Rather than blocking access to their phones, the app delivers small “missions” or tasks that encourage real-world habits aligned with the person users want to become.
The app joins a growing wave of anti-doomscrolling tools as more people look for ways to reduce social media addiction. What sets MeBeMe apart is its approach: instead of locking users out of distracting apps, it nudges them toward meaningful actions.
To get started, users choose an identity they want to embody, such as a “lifelong learner.” MeBeMe then sends occasional notifications with quick tasks related to that identity. For example, it might suggest watching an educational video for seven minutes. Someone who selects the “classics reader” identity could receive a mission to attend a local book club or lecture.
The app offers more than 75 identities across several categories. Under “Mind,” users can choose roles like mathematician, scientist, historian, or chess player. The “Body” category includes athlete, dancer, cyclist, and runner. There are also categories focused on relationships and home-based interests like cooking and gardening.
Users can select multiple identities at once, allowing them to build habits across different areas of their lives.
Users also control how often they receive notifications, whether that’s daily or just occasionally. A feature called “Break Your Scroll” even uses Siri to read the messages aloud.
MeBeMe officially launched last Wednesday. It was created by Eric Wolfram, who originally built the app for his son before realizing it was just as helpful for himself.
“Small actions, repeated over time, shape who you are,” Wolfram writes on his website. “Becoming who you are is a lifelong project.”
Wolfram also says privacy is one of MeBeMe’s defining features. The app requires no account, stores all user data on the device, and allows users to turn off anonymous usage data sharing.
MeBeMe is available as a free download for iOS devices, with an Android version coming soon. There are no ads or subscriptions.

title: Your backstage pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is waiting
summary: Volunteer at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and get a behind-the-scenes look at how one of the world's biggest startup conferences gets built.
full_text:
Volunteering at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 isn’t just about scoring free admission (though a free three-day pass is a pretty sweet perk). It’s your chance to get a behind-the-scenes look at how one of the world’s biggest startup conferences gets built — and to connect with the people shaping the future of tech while you’re doing it.
Whether you’re an aspiring founder looking to understand how world-class events operate, an event enthusiast wanting hands-on experience, or someone hungry for inspiration and connections, volunteering at Disrupt 2026 is your all-access pass to see how the magic happens.
TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 hits Moscone West in San Francisco this October 13–15, and we’d love to have you on the team. Learn more.
What you’ll get
As a volunteer, you’ll help bring the show to life — and in return, you’ll get:
- Free general admission for all three days of Disrupt 2026 (October 13–15).
- Hands-on experience producing one of the top startup events of the year.
- Direct connections with fellow volunteers and the Disrupt community.
- A front-row seat to pitches, announcements, and the newest breakthroughs in tech.
This is more than a ticket — it’s a foot in the door to the startup ecosystem.
Here’s what we need
To volunteer at Disrupt 2026, you’ll need to:
- Commit to at least 12 hours of volunteering before and during the conference days.
- Attend a mandatory in-person orientation on Monday, October 12 (afternoon).
- Be 18 years or older.
Local applicants are preferred, but we welcome people from anywhere. Spots are limited, so don’t wait. Application closes on September 25th.

title: Ford bets on Apple for its next-generation of EVs
summary: Ford is the first automaker to use a new set of developer tools that will let it embed Apple Maps navigation and mapping directly into its vehicles' infotainment systems.
full_text:
Apple on Thursday announced a new set of developer tools that will let automakers embed Apple Maps navigation and mapping directly into their vehicles’ infotainment systems.
The software development kit, called MapKit for Automotive, will debut with Ford and its new line of electric vehicles, starting with a $30,000 midsize truck in 2027.
Ford is placing a hefty bet on its next-generation of EVs, which it has promised will be affordable and efficient while still offering the latest technology. To build them, Ford ditched its century-old tradition and instead started with a universal EV platform, or UEV, that will underpin the midsize truck and eventually other vehicles including a sedan, crossover, three-row SUV and even small commercial vans.
Features like Apple Maps integration may seem minor compared to Ford’s decision to use single-piece aluminum unicastings for the vehicle, which are large components cast as one piece to eliminate parts and allow for faster assembly.
But the Apple Maps integration is central to Ford’s plan to deliver more responsive features to owners, such as navigation that includes efficient routing designed for EVs and turn-by-turn directions with natural language capabilities.
Drivers will be able to see real-time traffic and incident information, search for destinations, and view detailed place information. Importantly, Apple MapKit runs natively in the vehicle and is separate from Apple CarPlay, which mirrors apps from an iPhone onto the vehicle’s central display.
The integration will also feed road-level information from Apple Maps to Ford’s next-generation BlueCruise hands-free driver assistance system. The upgraded version of BlueCruise, which is expected to roll out next year, will be able to handle an entire highway journey, including entrance and exits ramps. The company has said the new system will ultimately handle “point-to-point autonomy,” similar to Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised) software, before progressing to eyes-off driving in 2028.
The companies said that by embedding Apple Maps directly in the vehicle, drivers will gain access to smarter EV routing, including battery preconditioning. This feature prepares the battery before arriving at a charger, reducing charge times by ensuring it’s at the optimal temperature.
It could also enable smart home integrations, like opening the garage door and turning on the lights when the driver arrives at home.
While the technology will be open to any automaker, Ford is Apple’s first partner on the new effort. The companies have signed a commercial agreement, but did not disclosed its terms.
Ford noted that the Apple integration could also help its Ford Pro business, which serves its commercial fleet customers. For example, businesses could use the technology to route drivers to their next job site or display other fleet vehicles on the map. Those kinds of fleet features become much easier when the mapping platform is built directly into the vehicle.

title: 高盛 CEO 力挺美國清晰度法案《Clarity Act》，小摩痛批穩定幣條款：遲早爆炸
summary:
美國加密貨幣監管法案《Clarity Act》在華爾街引發意見分歧！據《CoinDesk》報導，高盛（Gold […]

〈高盛 CEO 力挺美國清晰度法案《Clarity Act》，小摩痛批穩定幣條款：遲早爆炸〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
美國加密貨幣監管法案《Clarity Act》在華爾街引發意見分歧！據《CoinDesk》報導，高盛（Goldman Sachs）執行長 David Solomon 表態支持推進該法案，認為這有助於建立公平競爭的市場環境。此舉與摩根大通（JPMorgan）執行長 Jamie Dimon 等強烈反對「收益型穩定幣」條款的傳統銀行業巨頭，形成鮮明對比。
（前情提要：川普鬆口放行「倫理條款」，加密法案 CLARITY Act 衝刺參議院表決）
（背景補充：Clarity Act 清晰度法案卡關參議院！道德條款難產、川普白宮密會未表態，休會倒數引爆時間壓力）
在美國參議院即將對加密市場結構法案進行關鍵投票之際，華爾街頂級金融機構對此卻出現了罕見的意見分歧。據《CoinDesk》報導，高盛（Goldman Sachs）執行長 David Solomon 近日在接受訪問時，明確表達了對《Clarity Act》（數位資產市場清晰法案）的支持，為這項延宕多時的加密立法注入了一劑強心針。
高盛挺加密法案：建立公平競爭環境
Solomon 在接受《Politico》採訪時坦言，雖然《Clarity Act》並非完美，且條款內容仍有許多可辯論的空間，但他強調這項法案能創造出一個「公平競爭環境（level playing field）」。他認為這不僅能提升市場穩定性，更能讓數位資產市場獲得適當的發展空間。「我非常支持推動法案前進，這樣我們就能建立市場結構，開始推進創新進程，」Solomon 表示。
這番言論也呼應了 Solomon 今年初的立場，他曾多次批評過度監管會帶來龐大的經濟成本，並呼籲監管必須「深思熟慮，並且要做到正確」。據悉，共和黨參議員目前已散發法案的最新更新文本，旨在為數位資產建立明確監管框架，最快可能在下週進行參議院的全院投票。
小摩強烈反對：收益型穩定幣威脅銀行業
然而，Solomon 的樂觀支持，卻與以摩根大通（JPMorgan）為首的其他華爾街大行形成了強烈對比。爭議的核心焦點，落在法案中允許加密貨幣公司發行「收益型穩定幣（yield-bearing stablecoins）」的關鍵條款上。
摩根大通執行長 Jamie Dimon 先前受訪時曾嚴厲批評，該條款允許加密企業有效支付存款利息，卻無需受到傳統銀行同等的監管與消費者保護，使傳統銀行處於競爭劣勢。Dimon 警告銀行業絕對不會接受這種不公平的競爭方式，甚至預言這種監管漏洞「最終會爆炸」。摩根大通在 6 月發布的文章中也重申，提供類似傳統銀行帳戶產品的公司，理應受到相當的監督，立法應該是填補監管缺口，而非創造新的漏洞。
針對華爾街的反彈聲浪，Coinbase 執行長 Brian Armstrong 則反擊指出，銀行業積極遊說限制穩定幣收益，說穿了只是因為這項創新產品已實質威脅到傳統銀行的核心存款業務模式。《Clarity Act》能否在華爾街與加密產業的激烈角力中順利過關，將是未來幾週全球總體經濟與加密市場最關注的焦點。

title: 馬斯克籲 AI 巨頭互相審查！提議前沿模型「同行評審」，防 OpenAI 逃脫駭客事件重演
summary:
隨著前沿 AI 模型的潛在威脅日益升高，特斯拉執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）近日接受《經濟學人》專訪時提議 […]

〈馬斯克籲 AI 巨頭互相審查！提議前沿模型「同行評審」，防 OpenAI 逃脫駭客事件重演〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
隨著前沿 AI 模型的潛在威脅日益升高，特斯拉執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）近日接受《經濟學人》專訪時提議，全球領先的 AI 企業應針對最先進的模型進行「同行評審」，在正式發布前互相審查安全風險。他更直言，若企業無法解決嚴重的安全問題，政府就應當介入。此番言論適逢 OpenAI 爆出模型「逃脫」並駭入其他平台的駭人事件，讓 AI 防護機制的討論再度升溫。
（前情提要：特斯拉財報今晚來襲！馬斯克會將 SpaceX 與 Tesla 合併、組建 3 兆美元 AI 帝國？）
（背景補充：馬斯克痛批 AI 企業自稱實驗室「做作又有害」，狠酸矽谷病態階級文化）
隨著人工智慧（AI）能力呈指數級躍升，確保前沿 AI 模型（frontier AI models）的安全性已成為全球科技圈的迫切課題。據《路透》報導，知名科技富豪馬斯克（Elon Musk）近日在接受《經濟學人》（The Economist）專訪時，強烈呼籲全球領先的 AI 企業應該對彼此最先進的模型進行「同行評審（peer review）」。他建議在這些強大模型正式對外發布前，應由競爭對手先行審查，以共同應對 AI 快速發展所伴隨的潛在風險。
呼籲巨頭定期會議，推動同行評審
在約於本週一（21 日）錄製的訪談中，馬斯克針對當前的 AI 安全困境提出了具體的解決方案。「我們目前能做的最立竿見影之事，就是讓領先的 AI 公司⋯⋯每隔幾週開一次會，單純討論任何關於安全性與防護的問題，」馬斯克在受訪時表示。
他主張，透過這種定期的對話機制，競爭對手能有充足的時間在模型實際部署前，審查彼此的新技術並標記潛在的安全漏洞。馬斯克一向警告先進 AI 可能對人類帶來「存在性風險（existential risks）」，他認為相較於政府，AI 開發者處於更佳的位置，能及早發現技術風險。然而他也強調，如果某家公司在審查後未能解決嚴重的安全問題，那這就是「政府介入並採取行動的時刻」。
OpenAI「逃脫事件」敲響警鐘
值得注意的是，馬斯克提出這項倡議的時間點，恰巧早於近期震驚業界的 OpenAI 安全漏洞事件。本週稍早，OpenAI 官方披露，其開發的兩個前沿 AI 模型在受控的沙盒測試環境中出現了「令人不安的自主行為」。
這些模型不僅成功「逃脫」了隔離環境，取得了網際網路的存取權限，甚至還駭入了開源 AI 平台 Hugging Face，目的是為了獲取內部網路安全基準測試的解答。這起事件無疑印證了馬斯克的擔憂，也引發了外界對於目前先進 AI 防護措施是否足夠的廣泛質疑與熱烈討論。
監管壓力漸增，政府與企業角力
目前，包含美國、歐洲在內的各國政府，正積極考量該如何有效監管這些前沿 AI 系統。同時，美國國會也正研擬針對 AI 的「殺死開關（kill switch）」法案，以防範技術失控。
然而，現階段多數 AI 企業仍主要依賴內部的自願性安全承諾與封閉測試來把關。馬斯克的「同行評審」提議，試圖在過度僵化的政府監管與企業各自為政的自律之間，尋找一條具備技術專業與制衡機制的第三條路。這項倡議能否獲得 OpenAI、Google 等巨頭的響應，將是未來 AI 產業走向的關鍵指標。

title: Anthropic 衝刺 IPO！傳強制員工簽「10b5-1 自動賣股」計畫，防 9,650 億美元估值拋售潮
summary:
隨著首次公開發行（IPO）腳步逼近，知名人工智慧新創 Anthropic 正採取極為罕見的合規措施：為避免潛在 […]

〈Anthropic 衝刺 IPO！傳強制員工簽「10b5-1 自動賣股」計畫，防 9,650 億美元估值拋售潮〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
隨著首次公開發行（IPO）腳步逼近，知名人工智慧新創 Anthropic 正採取極為罕見的合規措施：為避免潛在的內線交易風險並保護公司文化，Anthropic 內部正考慮強制「全體員工」採用 10b5-1 股票交易計畫。這意味著所有員工在出售公司股票前，必須提前排定交易時間與數量，這對一家尚未正式上市的公司而言，是相當激進且前衛的做法。
（前情提要：Anthropic 年營收破 740 億美元遠超 OpenAI！後者兩個月狂增近 3 成急追）
（背景補充：Anthropic 開放 Claude Security 外掛 beta，可用 AI Agent 掃碼、寫好更新檔）
開發出強大 Claude 系列模型的 AI 巨頭 Anthropic，正加速邁向公開市場。據了解，該公司已於 2026 年 6 月初向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）機密提交了 Form S-1 草稿，預計最快將於今年 9 月正式掛牌上市。然而，在估值暴漲與即將迎來巨大財富變現之際，Anthropic 管理層正考慮實施一項顛覆傳統的合規政策：要求全體員工強制參與 10b5-1 股票交易計畫。
什麼是 10b5-1 計畫？為何成為員工賣股護身符？
在美國證券市場中，10b5-1 計畫猶如內部人士專用的「股票銷售自動駕駛系統」。透過該計畫，員工必須在實際交易前，提前決定好未來出售股票的時間、價格與數量，並將其寫成正式的書面計畫交由系統自動執行。
這項機制的核心目的在於避免「內線交易」的法律指控。SEC 在 2022 年大幅更新了相關規則，增加了強制冷卻期（Cooling-off period），並要求高管必須誠實認證自己並未掌握任何「重大非公開資訊（MNPI）」。對於正處於 IPO 關鍵期的 Anthropic 而言，財務顧問強烈建議員工採用此計畫，這不僅能幫助員工在 IPO 前後的交易黑窗期（Blackout period）順利獲得流動性，更能為公司與個人提供強大的法律保護傘。
工程師也是「內線」？為保全公司開放文化
在傳統的科技新創公司中，通常只有高階主管或能接觸到核心財務數據的員工會被視為「內線人士」。然而，Anthropic 的情況卻截然不同。由於該公司致力於開發最前沿的 AI 模型，即便是基層的軟體工程師，對模型尚未公開的強大能力與突破的了解，在法律定義上也極可能構成「重大非公開資訊」。
因此，財務顧問認為 Anthropic 的「全體員工」都可能被視為受交易限制的內線人士。採取強制性的 10b5-1 計畫，雖然看似保守且限制了員工對賣股時機的彈性，但這能讓 Anthropic 在不面臨內線交易風險的前提下，繼續維持內部「廣泛共享資訊」的開放文化，避免因為合規問題而在內部築起資訊高牆。
防範估值狂飆後的「IPO 拋售潮」
這項強制計畫的另一個重要考量，是為了穩定上市後的股價表現。數據顯示，Anthropic 的估值在短短三年內，從約 40 億美元一路狂飆至最新 H 輪融資後的 9,650 億美元（Post-money），其年化營收更已突破 470 億美元大關。
面對員工手中價值可能高達「改變人生」級別的股權，若在傳統的 180 天 IPO 鎖定期（Lock-up）結束後同時拋售，必將對市場造成毀滅性的賣壓。透過 10b5-1 計畫的預先安排，員工的賣股行為將被迫在不同時間點分散執行，這不僅能平滑市場的供給衝擊，也有助於 Anthropic 在資本市場上維持長期且穩定的價格表現。目前該政策尚未做出最終拍板，但已在矽谷與華爾街引發熱烈討論。

title: 科技股面臨油價、美債、美元「三重壓制」！分析師：川普如何應對中東危機成關鍵
summary:
全球總體經濟環境正迎來嚴峻考驗！據 X 平台知名宏觀分析師 @qinbafrank 最新發布的市場觀點指出，隨 […]

〈科技股面臨油價、美債、美元「三重壓制」！分析師：川普如何應對中東危機成關鍵〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
全球總體經濟環境正迎來嚴峻考驗！據 X 平台知名宏觀分析師 @qinbafrank 最新發布的市場觀點指出，隨著布蘭特原油逼近 100 美元、10 年期美債殖利率突破 4.7% 以及美元指數站上 101，風險資產將面臨嚴峻的「三重壓制」。他警告，若油價持續居高不下，以納斯達克為首的大型科技股將承受最大壓力；而川普政府在中東地緣政治上的進退兩難，將成為決定未來市場走向的核心變數。
（前情提要：川普點頭美沙「民用核能協議」！開出關鍵條件：沙烏地需加入《亞伯拉罕協議》）
（背景補充：川普警告伊朗：若胡塞武裝再犯，將面臨「重大軍事懲罰」！）
隨著多項總經數據與地緣政治風險疊加，風險資產可能面臨新一輪的洗禮。台北時間 7 月 23 日，X 平台知名宏觀分析師 qinbafrank 發布了最新的市場觀察，直言當前市場前景「不容樂觀」。他指出，儘管韓國股市的去槓桿化出現了可喜的進展，且 Google 財報確認了 AI 需求持續飆升，但資本支出的提升與自由現金流轉負，加上迎面而來的宏觀壓力，正讓市場陷入高度警戒。
晚上布油快摸到100，十年美债收益率突破4.7%，美元指数再度站上101。如7月21号晚上聊到的“短期内几个资产各按各的逻辑走其实没问题，但中期这样一定会出问题”。
风险资产上，韩股去杠杆接有可喜进展如今天https://t.co/TRsWzXFkyP聊到。… https://t.co/JxWY17TIOx pic.twitter.com/FD2QYNHgmU
— qinbafrank (@qinbafrank) July 23, 2026
油價、美債、美元齊發威，科技股首當其衝
qinbafrank 在貼文中明確點出了當前市場面臨的三大宏觀壓力：首先是油價持續上漲，大幅推高了通膨預期；其次，10 年期美債殖利率上行，嚴重壓低了股票市場的估值；最後，美元指數走強，正持續抽緊全球資金的流動性。
他警告，在風險資產去槓桿尚未完全出清的情況下，如果布蘭特原油（Brent）成功突破 100 美元、美國原油（WTI）站穩 90 美元，且 10 年期美債殖利率與美元指數分別強勢維持在 4.7% 及 101 上方，那麼以納斯達克指數為代表的「大型科技股」將成為全市場承受最大壓力的地方，甚至連傳統避險資產黃金也會被迫繼續承壓。
中東危機成核心變數，川普面臨進退兩難
這場宏觀風暴的解藥在哪裡？qinbafrank 直言，核心關鍵依然在於「油價」。如果油價不回落，總體經濟的風險壓制就很難解除。然而，近期的地緣政治發展卻為油價走勢蒙上陰影，包含霍爾木茲海峽開闢新航線的失利，以及美軍士兵的傷亡，都讓局勢變得更加複雜難解。
他分析指出，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）可能還未接受一個殘酷的現實：美國已經無法將霍爾木茲海峽恢復至戰前狀態。為了安撫國內反對聲音、維持支持率以應對大選，川普必須時不時展現強硬態度。但另一方面，儘管美國擁有絕對的空中與遠程打擊優勢，伊朗依然保留了足以製造全球能源衝擊的「非對稱能力」。
妥協還是升級？市場靜待下一步
對於未來的發展劇本，qinbafrank 認為川普面臨著極度艱難的抉擇。對美國而言，要麼選擇變相買回海峽的國際航權（即支付巨額資金讓伊朗放棄控制權），要麼選擇徹底摧毀伊朗政權與軍事實力，但目前看來，川普並無意走到全面開戰這一步。
究竟是徹底退讓認清現實、變相買斷，還是以更強硬的軍事手段進一步升級？分析師預期，川普短期內很難立刻轉向，或許需要感受到市場的「極度悲觀和壓力」後，才會做出實質退讓。在此之前，投資人應對全球風險資產保持高度警戒，靜觀其變。

title: 阿布達比主權財富基金進軍 RWA！聯手 Coinbase 發行代幣化基金，吸金 7500 萬鎂
summary:
據《Fortune》報導，管理近 4,000 億美元資產的阿布達比主權財富基金 Mubadala Capita […]

〈阿布達比主權財富基金進軍 RWA！聯手 Coinbase 發行代幣化基金，吸金 7500 萬鎂〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
據《Fortune》報導，管理近 4,000 億美元資產的阿布達比主權財富基金 Mubadala Capital，已聯手 Coinbase 與基礎設施提供商 KAIO，將其私人市場基金轉化為區塊鏈原生的代幣化資產。Coinbase 更親自認購該代幣納入公司資金庫，創下美國大型上市公司鏈上資金管理的首例。
（前情提要：RWA 代幣化股票市值飆漲 5 倍！a16z：AI 晶片成大熱門，傳統金融加速上鏈）
（背景補充：84% 華爾街機構已將代幣化列為優先策略：傳統＋數位混合市場將成主流）
隨著現實世界資產（RWA）代幣化浪潮席捲全球，傳統金融巨頭的參與層級正在快速提升。台北時間 7 月 23 日，據《Fortune》報導，阿布達比最大國有基金之一、資產管理規模近 4,000 億美元的 Mubadala Capital 宣布，將把其「長期私人市場基金（evergreen private markets fund）」代幣化，正式開放給合格投資者參與。這不僅是主權財富基金首次大規模參與代幣化的重要里程碑，更象徵著主流金融與加密生態圈的進一步交融。
Coinbase 親自下場買進！創上市企業鏈上資金管理首例
在這次的重大合作中，美國最大加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase 扮演了雙重關鍵角色。報導指出，Coinbase 不僅提供其開發的 Base 區塊鏈作為該代幣化基金的運行網路之一，更直接出資購買了該代幣，將 Mubadala 基金正式納入公司的資產負債表中。
這項創舉被外界譽為「美國主要上市公司首次使用受監管代幣化資產進行原生鏈上資金管理」的絕佳範例。此外，為了滿足不同生態系的需求與流動性，該代幣化基金除了在 Base 網路上運行，未來也計畫支援 Solana 與 Sui 等高效能區塊鏈。
降低私募門檻，KAIO 助攻募資 7,500 萬美元
負責提供本次基礎設施支援的，是曾為貝萊德（BlackRock）與 Brevan Howard 等頂級機構提供代幣化服務的 KAIO 平台。KAIO 執行長 Shrey Rastogi 指出，這類私人市場基金的交易通常高度封閉，沒有深厚私人銀行關係的散戶或個人投資者往往難以接觸。如今透過代幣化技術，Mubadala 能夠順利擴大投資者池，讓包含加密原生資金在內的更多合格投資者得以輕鬆參與。
據了解，投資者在參與前，必須先透過授權的基金管理人完成離鏈（off-chain）的盡職調查，隨後便能獲得鏈上的專屬個人資料，進而控制並認購相關產品。目前，KAIO 已成功為該基金募集了約 7,500 萬美元，資金來源涵蓋了傳統機構與加密原生的資產配置者。
RWA 爆發性成長，市值年增 4 倍
根據 a16z crypto 先前發布的報告數據顯示，代幣化資產市場在過去一年內迎來了爆發性的成長，總市值飆升約 400%，達到約 17 億美元的規模。
過去，這股資產上鏈的趨勢主要由 Coinbase、幣安（Binance）、Robinhood 以及華爾街傳統機構所推動；如今，隨著 Mubadala 這類國家級主權財富基金的重磅加入，預期將為整個加密市場帶來更龐大的流動性，並吸引更多傳統私募股權與債權資產加速上鏈。

title: 貝萊德、Strategy 等 9 大巨頭聯手成立「比特幣安全聯盟」！挹注 1,500 萬美元防禦量子威脅
summary:
比特幣底層安全迎來華爾街與加密巨頭的重量級護航！據 Strategy（前身為微策略）於 23 日發布的官方新聞 […]

〈貝萊德、Strategy 等 9 大巨頭聯手成立「比特幣安全聯盟」！挹注 1,500 萬美元防禦量子威脅〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
比特幣底層安全迎來華爾街與加密巨頭的重量級護航！據 Strategy（前身為微策略）於 23 日發布的官方新聞稿指出，包含貝萊德、Coinbase、富達在內的 9 家頂級金融機構與加密企業，正式宣布聯合成立「比特幣安全聯盟（Bitcoin Security Consortium）」。該聯盟承諾在未來三年內獨立資助總計 1,500 萬美元，專門支持開源開發者、後量子密碼學研究及安全教育，以鞏固比特幣網路的長期安全性與韌性。
（前情提要：Galaxy Digital 推出「比特幣量子就緒計劃」，砸 500 萬鎂資助後量子密碼開發）
（背景補充：美國政府變身「主權基金」目前已入股 26 家公司，橫跨稀土、半導體、量子運算、核能..下個買誰？）
隨著比特幣逐漸成為全球金融體系的核心資產，其底層網路的安全性與長期演進備受機構高度關注。台北時間 7 月 23 日，全球最大比特幣國庫公司 Strategy 攜手多家傳統金融巨頭與原生加密機構，共同宣布成立「比特幣安全聯盟（Bitcoin Security Consortium）」，旨在透過長期資金挹注，確保比特幣開源生態系在面對未來技術挑戰（如量子計算）時依然固若金湯。
9 家產業巨頭響應，三年挹注 1,500 萬美元
創立該聯盟的 9 家機構涵蓋了資產管理公司、託管機構、交易所、基礎設施提供者與支付巨頭，創始成員包含：Anchorage Digital、ARK Invest、貝萊德（BlackRock）、Block、Blockstream、Coinbase、富達數位資產（Fidelity Digital Assets）、Galaxy 以及 Strategy。
根據公告，聯盟成員將在未來三年內獨立承諾資助總計 1,500 萬美元的資金。值得一提的是，聯盟並不設有集中式的共同資金池，而是由每家成員獨立決定其資助對象與計畫。聯盟的日常協調工作，將由專注資助比特幣開源開發者的非營利組織 Brink 執行董事 Mike Schmidt 以志願者身分負責。
防範未來量子威脅，強調「不干預協議治理」
比特幣安全聯盟成立的核心目標，除了定期提供客觀且可靠的安全狀態資訊給投資人、公眾與媒體外，更將「後量子密碼學（Post-quantum cryptography）」列為長期的優先研究方向。雖然目前尚未出現能威脅比特幣密碼學的大規模量子電腦，但聯盟認為提早佈局與研究是維護網路長期穩健的關鍵步驟。
聯盟同時發表嚴正聲明，強調其運作模式遵循傳統科技界對開源軟體的支持方式：聯盟不會控制或指導比特幣協議的發展、不對特定的協議變更發表立場，亦不代表比特幣及其開發者。比特幣的開發與治理，將繼續完全由全球去中心化的開源社群主導。
機構挺身維護底層，展現長期公有財承諾
Strategy 執行長 Phong Le 在公告中表示：「作為比特幣的長期持有者，我們有強烈的動機確保比特幣網路具備世代級別的安全。資助相關安全工作並引導客觀對話，是我們自然而然的貢獻方式。」
貝萊德全球數位資產主管 Robert Mitchnick 也指出：「比特幣核心開發者承擔了極其重要的工作，我們很高興能提供額外的重大資金支持，以滿足比特幣的長期安全需求。」

title: 川普點頭美沙「民用核能協議」！開出關鍵條件：沙烏地需加入《亞伯拉罕協議》
summary:

full_text:
美國中東政策迎來重大進展！據美國總統川普（Donald Trump）今日於 Truth Social 平台發布的最新聲明，美國能源部與沙烏地阿拉伯之間關於「民用核能協議」即將獲得批准。然而，川普開出了一個關鍵的附帶條件：沙烏地阿拉伯必須正式加入《亞伯拉罕協議》（Abraham Accords）。此舉顯示美國正試圖透過核能合作，進一步推動中東地區的和平與外交重組。
（前情提要：川普警告伊朗：若胡塞武裝再犯，將面臨「重大軍事懲罰」！）
（背景補充：川普全球10%關稅本週到期，擬新祭「強迫勞動關稅」台灣預估稅率為何？）
在全球能源格局與地緣政治持續動盪之際，美國與中東大國沙烏地阿拉伯的雙邊合作再次成為市場焦點。台北時間 7 月 23 日，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）透過其社群平台 Truth Social 發布了一項重大的外交政策聲明，證實美國即將批准與沙烏地阿拉伯的民用核能協議。
美沙民用核能協議將獲准，強調「無濃縮材料」
川普在聲明中明確指出，這項由美國能源部（Department of Energy）與沙烏地阿拉伯達成的民用核能協議，將嚴格限制在「非軍事用途（non-military use）」的範疇內。他特別強調，該協議中「不會包含核材料的濃縮（There will be no enrichment of material!）」，確保了這項合作的純民用性質。
為了緩解外界對於核擴散的疑慮，川普也以其他中東國家作為對比，指出這種非濃縮的民用核設施，就如同伊朗和阿拉伯聯合大公國（UAE）等國家已經擁有的設施一樣。他表示：「美國並不反對民用（非濃縮）核設施。」
核協議的關鍵籌碼：加入《亞伯拉罕協議》
儘管川普對這項民用核能協議開了綠燈，但這份大禮並非沒有代價。川普在聲明中拋出了一個具有高度地緣政治影響力的附帶條件 —— 這項協議的批准，將「完全取決於（totally subject to）」沙烏地阿拉伯加入《亞伯拉罕協議》。
《亞伯拉罕協議》是川普上一任期內推動的重要外交成就，旨在促成以色列與多個阿拉伯國家實現關係正常化。川普在聲明中稱讚該協議「備受尊崇且非常成功（very respected and successful）」。若沙烏地阿拉伯作為伊斯蘭世界的領頭羊，願意點頭加入該協議，無疑將是中東和平進程的一大歷史性突破。

title: 川普警告伊朗：若胡塞武裝再犯，將面臨「重大軍事懲罰」！
summary:
美國總統川普（Donald Trump）最新在社群平台發文警告，針對胡塞武裝昨夜襲擊兩艘沙烏地阿拉伯船隻的行為 […]

〈川普警告伊朗：若胡塞武裝再犯，將面臨「重大軍事懲罰」！〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
美國總統川普（Donald Trump）最新在社群平台發文警告，針對胡塞武裝昨夜襲擊兩艘沙烏地阿拉伯船隻的行為，他感到「非常失望」。川普強硬表態，若胡塞武裝再次發動攻擊，美國將直接追究其背後支持者伊朗的責任，並對伊朗及胡塞武裝實施嚴厲的重大軍事懲罰。
（前情提要：川普喊晶片回美國！台積電毛利率要被吃掉 4 個百分點，2027 再漲價？）
（背景補充：川普全球10%關稅本週到期，擬新祭「強迫勞動關稅」台灣預估稅率為何？）
全球總體經濟與地緣政治風險再度迎來巨大變數。美國總統川普（Donald Trump）最新在旗下社群平台 Truth Social 發表強硬聲明，針對葉門胡塞武裝（Houthis）近期恢復攻擊商船的行為發出最後通牒，並將矛頭直接對準其背後的最大支持者 —— 伊朗。
胡塞再度襲擊沙國船隻，川普直言「極度失望」
川普在貼文中回顧道，一年前美國曾因為胡塞武裝干擾商業貿易及襲擊船隻，對其進行了極具威力的軍事打擊。他指出，自那次行動之後，尤其是在美國與伊朗發生衝突的期間，胡塞武裝一直表現得「非常負責任」。
然而，這份短暫的平靜已被打破。川普指出，胡塞武裝昨晚向兩艘沙烏地阿拉伯船隻開火，重新挑起了區域爭端。他對此表達了強烈的不滿，直言對胡塞武裝感到「非常失望」，因為在此之前，他們一直表現得相當「專業且聰明」。
警告伊朗：再犯將實施重大軍事懲罰
面對紅海與中東衝突重燃的威脅，川普透過貼文發出了極為嚴厲的軍事警告。他明確表示，這篇聲明就是要向外界確立一個堅定的立場：如果胡塞武裝再次發動攻擊，美國將直接追究伊朗的責任。
川普強調，胡塞武裝實質上就是伊朗的代理人（Surrogate and/or Proxy）。一旦越過紅線，美國不僅會懲罰胡塞武裝本身，更將對伊朗實施「重大軍事懲罰」。這番話顯示美國的打擊範圍已不再侷限於葉門境內，而是可能直接升級至與伊朗的正面衝突。
地緣風險飆升，市場恐迎劇烈震盪
作為全球原油運輸與國際貿易的關鍵咽喉，中東地區的穩定對總體經濟至關重要。川普此次將伊朗直接納入軍事打擊目標的強硬表態，無疑讓波斯灣局勢瞬間緊繃。
分析指出，未來若衝突實質升級，不僅可能引發國際原油價格短線暴漲，更可能導致避險情緒在全球市場迅速蔓延。對於包含比特幣在內的加密貨幣等風險資產而言，這種宏觀級別的地緣政治震盪，將是投資人近期必須密切關注的重大風險指標。

title: 預測市場踩進「體育博弈」紅線？美國會評估修法，CFTC 管轄權成焦點
summary:
美國眾議院針對體育預測市場召開公聽會，聚焦監管權責應歸屬聯邦商品期貨交易委員會，或交由各州博彩主管機關管理。

〈預測市場踩進「體育博弈」紅線？美國會評估修法，CFTC 管轄權成焦點〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Max，加密城市
眾院重啟公聽會，預測市場管轄權成焦點
美國眾議院農業委員會旗下「商品市場、數位資產與農村發展小組委員會」於 7 月 21 日召開公聽會，主題聚焦體育事件預測市場的客戶保護與市場完整性。隨著 Polymarket 、 Kalshi 等平台讓使用者押注選舉、體育賽事與公共事件結果，國會再度面臨一個關鍵問題：這類合約應由聯邦商品監管機構管理，或交由各州博彩主管機關處理。
小組委員會主席 Dusty Johnson 表示，預測市場已存在多年，但技術發展讓其規模與能見度快速擴張，近兩年的變化超出監管機關原先預期。現行法律正被迫回答過去未曾預設的問題，國會需要釐清 CFTC 是否具備足夠工具，監督快速成長的事件合約市場。
Chairman Johnson had 4 takeaways from today’s hearing on prediction markets.
1. CFTC does have important work to do.
2. Everyone agrees on market integrity and customer protection.
3. This subcommittee needs to explore if there are enough tools to ensure market integrity and… pic.twitter.com/L4wSfk8LKe— Coalition for Prediction Markets (@PredictAction) July 21, 2026
體育事件合約擴張，金融產品與博彩界線模糊
公聽會核心爭點在於體育相關預測市場的法律定位。
- 支持聯邦監管的一方認為，事件合約若在 CFTC 監管下交易，應被視為金融衍生性金融商品的一種，平台需遵守市場完整性、風控、揭露與客戶保護要求。
- 反對者則認為，使用者押注球賽勝負、本壘打數或冠軍結果，實質上與體育博彩高度相似，若繞過州博彩牌照，將削弱各州多年建立的監管制度。
Johnson 在會中指出，衍生性金融商品市場原本服務於風險管理與價格發現，國會必須判斷體育事件合約是否仍符合這類金融目的。若平台只以娛樂投注形式吸引使用者，便會牽動博彩法、消費者保護、未成年人防護與問題賭博等議題。這也是預測市場從小眾金融工具走向大眾市場後，監管衝突快速升高的原因。
CFTC 與州政府角力，平台面臨多線壓力
目前美國聯邦層級由商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）監管特定事件合約，但州政府長期掌握體育博彩牌照與執法權。隨著體育預測合約交易量升高，多州監管機關開始挑戰平台合法性，主張相關產品若涉及體育賽事結果，就應遵守當地博彩規範。加密與區塊鏈產業團體則擔心，若各州可逐一否定聯邦核准的事件合約，將破壞全國衍生性金融商品市場的一致性。
政治壓力也持續升高。 6 月時，參議員 John Curtis 與 Adam Schiff 曾要求 CFTC 調查 Polymarket，原因是外界指控該平台透過網紅行銷活動接觸美國使用者。雖然 Polymarket 過去已因美國使用者限制問題遭監管處分，近期相關爭議顯示，離岸平台、區塊鏈交易與美國流量之間的邊界仍難完全切割。
市場交易量擴大，國會評估是否修法
預測市場相較整體 CFTC 監管的衍生性金融商品市場仍屬小規模，但成長速度已足以吸引國會注意。部分平台每月交易量達數十億美元，市場主題也從政治選舉與經濟數據，延伸至體育賽事、娛樂事件與即時新聞。這種擴張讓事件合約不再只是專業投資人用於避險的工具，也逐漸接觸大量一般使用者。
公聽會並未立即形成新法案，但已釋出明確訊號：國會將檢視現行商品法是否足以處理預測市場的新型態風險。接下來的討論重點，將包括 CFTC 權限是否需要擴大、州政府能否限制聯邦核准產品、平台是否需要更嚴格的客戶身分驗證與風險揭露，以及體育事件合約是否應另設專門規則。隨著預測市場與體育博彩的邊界持續交疊，美國監管大戰才剛進入新回合。
（以上內容獲合作夥伴《加密城市》授權節錄及轉載，原文連結 ）

title: 前 CFTC 主席、 Circle 總裁 Tarbert：一邊勸你長期主義，一邊套現 3 千萬美元
summary:
前 CFTC 主席、 Circle 總裁 Heath Tarbert 嘴上宣揚長期主義，私下卻在 Circle 上市後持續套現，累計出售超 36 萬股，套現逾 3000 萬美元，且從未增持。此舉引發投資人強烈不滿，尤其在股價較高點暴跌七成之際，瑞穗證券亦將 Circle 評等下調至「弱於大盤」。

〈前 CFTC 主席、 Circle 總裁 Tarbert：一邊勸你長期主義，一邊套現 3 千萬美元〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Zen，PANews
Circle 專注於長期發展，相信股價終會給出答案。
面對股價較高點跌去七成，市值蒸發的慘淡事實。 7 月 14 日，前 CFTC 主席、 Circle 總裁 Heath Tarbert 在接受 FOX Business 採訪時，當被主持人問及想對那些在 Circle 股價歷史高點買入股票的投資者說些什麼時，他不緊不慢地發表上述觀點。
而現實對 Cricle 並不利，瑞穗證券美國公司（Mizuho Securities USA LLC）分析師日前將 Circle 的評級從「中性」下調至「弱於大盤」，並給出了華爾街最低的 50 美元目標價。
眼看著股價一路下跌，呼籲普通股東選擇長期主義、保持耐心確實是身為總裁的 Tarbert 的份內工作。然而，當他被爆出自 Circle 完成 IPO 以來，一直持續拋售 CRCL 股票，累計套現約 3000 萬美元且從未有過增持。這種人前人後的極端差異，顯得特別諷刺。
瘋狂套現，將嘴巴上的長期主義留給市場
政商旋轉門是美國官員卸任後的經典劇本。身為對加密貨幣友善的前 CFTC 主席，Heath Tarbert 在 2023 年 7 月加入 Circle，擔任首席法務長兼企業事務負責人。 Tarbert 的定位顯然是要利用其橫跨美國財政部、 CFTC 、白宮和華爾街的履歷，幫助 Circle 與監管機構溝通，以加速業務成長和上市，以及推動 USDC 進入傳統金融體系。
Tarbert 本人也曾表示，他重視 Circle「監管優先」的發展方式，希望推動建立清晰、一致的數位資產規則。 2025 年初，他進一步升任 Circle 首任總裁，主管法律、合規、風險、公共政策、傳播和國際擴張等事務。
從公開言論來看，Tarbert 幾乎一直是 Circle「長期主義」敘事最積極的推銷者之一。他一再強調，穩定幣不應只被理解為加密交易工具，而是下一代支付、結算和網路金融基礎設施。而 Circle 當前的投入，不能簡單用短期獲利或股價波動來衡量。
但在個人持股的問題上，他早在 Circle 上市前夕便制定了與自己的公開立場截然不同的安排。 2025 年 6 月 4 日，也就是 Circle 確定 IPO 發行價格、正式掛牌的前一天，Tarbert 設立了一項 10b5-1 交易計劃，準備在一年內出售最多 35.329 萬股 Circle 股票。
於是，在上市後的 13 個月裡，他有 7 個月都在賣出股票，累計出售超過 36 萬股，套現金額超過 3000 萬美元。其中，在 2026 年 3 月 2 日，Tarbert 單次出售 12.2007 萬股，價值約 1150 萬美元，是所有交易中最大的一筆。
10b5-1 計畫允許高階主管在不掌握重大非公開資訊時，預先設定未來出售股票的時間、數量或價格條件，避免根據內線資訊臨時交易。 Tarbert 的大部分出售，都透過此類計畫由經紀商自動執行交易，獲利約為 2,440 萬美元。
或許 Tarbert 認為他出貨的強度還不夠猛烈，在第一輪交易計畫尚未完全結束，Tarbert 又於 2026 年 3 月 10 日制定了下一輪 10b5-1 計畫。準備在今年年底前繼續出售最多 16 萬股，其中包括透過行使選擇權獲得的股份。而自 Circle 上市以來，Tarbert 從未有在公開市場主動買進公司股票。
事實上，公司高階主管出售部分股權、分散個人資產，本來十分常見。但令社群不滿的是，即使在股價較高位置大規模套現之後，當股價下跌約四分之三時，他仍然在強調市場堅持長期主義，但自己卻無意在公開市場增持。這不免會讓人以為，Tarbert 其實只想撈把錢就撤，而從未對 Circle 的長遠發展真正有過信心。
玩轉政商旋轉門，曾卸任 CFTC 主席 27 天後加入城堡證券
實際上在進入進入 Circle 核心管理階層之前，Tarbert 就非常善於利用其美國政治和商業資源變現。
他早年接受法律和金融訓練，曾在美國白宮、參議院銀行委員會和財政部任職，也曾擔任國際律所 Allen & Overy 銀行監管業務負責人。川普政府時期，Tarbert 出任美國財政部負責國際市場的助理部長，參與 G7 、 G20 、金融穩定委員會以及歐美金融監管協調，並一度代理財政部國際事務副部長。
2019 年，川普提名 Tarbert 擔任 CFTC 主席。由於他既有共和黨政府經歷，也具備銀行監理、國際金融和法律專業背景，其提名並未遭遇明顯阻力。參議院最終以 84 票贊成、 9 票反對確認其擔任主席，任期原本持續至 2024 年 4 月。
2020 年總統大選後，民主黨重新入主白宮，Tarbert 在拜登就職當天主動退下。其公開理由是為新總統選擇常任主席讓路，這屬於美國監管機構在政黨輪替後的正常權力交接。
不過，Tarbert 原本可以繼續以一般委員身分留任至 2024 年，卻在 2021 年 3 月 5 日提前辭去全部職務。 27 天后，Tarbert 迅速進入一家受金融監理政策直接影響的頭部做市商城堡證券，擔任首席法務官。
這段經歷後來也塑造了外在對他的基本印象──十分擅長進入監理體系、累積制度資源，再把這些資源轉化為大型金融公司的合規、遊說和政策影響能力。
從城堡證券到 Circle，爭議從「旋轉門」開始
除了卸任監管要職後不足一個月便轉身進入城堡證券擔任高管，Tarbert 看起來「緊急」加入這家公司的具體時點，同樣引發了外界質疑。
2021 年初，大量散戶集中買入 GameStop 等被機構重倉做空的股票，推動股價急劇上漲，部分空頭基金因此遭受龐大損失。就在行情最激烈時，Robinhood 突然限制用戶買進 GameStop 、 AMC 等股票，卻仍允許賣出，相關股價隨即大幅回落。部分投資人隨後指控 Robinhood 與城堡證券合謀壓低股價，認為平台透過關閉「買進按鈕」削弱散戶買盤，為華爾街空頭解圍。
在這次風波中，城堡證券成為了被懷疑的焦點。原因在於一方面是它是 Robinhood 最重要的訂單執行方和訂單流付款來源之一；另一方面，其創始人肯·格里芬旗下的對沖基金 Citadel 剛剛向遭 GameStop 逼空重創的 Melvin Capital 注資。此時，這家頭部做市商正面臨國會、監管機構和輿論的集中檢視。
而就在這敏感階段，剛離開 CFTC 的 Tarbert 便恰好出任城堡證券首席法務官，負責處理法律、合規和監管事務。 Tarbert 掌握監管機構運作邏輯、政策制定過程和華盛頓人脈，而城堡證券當時最需要的，恰恰是應對國會調查和可能出現的市場結構改革的能力。
進入城堡證券後，Tarbert 也沒有停留在傳統法律事務上。 2023 年，在他擔任首席法務官期間，城堡證券強烈反對 SEC 提出的零售訂單競價改革。 SEC 希望部分散戶訂單在成交前接受公開競價，以增加做市商之間的競爭。城堡證券則提交長篇意見，稱 SEC 的經濟分析存在嚴重錯誤，改革屬於未經驗證的「激進實驗」，可能損害散戶的成交品質。
類似的利益交叉也出現在加密市場。 2022 年 9 月，Tarbert 以城堡證券首席法務官身分出席美國參議院聽證會，支持《數位商品消費者保護法案》，主張擴大 CFTC 對加密現貨市場的監管權限。同時，城堡證券已獲得紅杉資本和加密投資機構 Paradigm 的 11.5 億美元投資，並公開表示計劃將業務拓展至加密資產。
從時間順序來看，一名前 CFTC 主席在加入準備進軍加密市場的做市商後，又公開推動擴大 CFTC 對相關市場的權力，難免使外界懷疑：他究竟是在以監管者的身份設計公共規則，還是在幫助潛在新雇主提前塑造一個更有利的市場環境？
2023 年，Tarbert 離開城堡證券，轉而加入 Circle 。而在 2022 年底，受制於監管環境，Cricle 策劃的 SAPC 方式上市計畫告吹。隨後，Circle 迫切需要一個深諳政治的高層來為他清除上市障礙，尋求直接 IPO 上市。兩年後，Circle 順利完成上市，Tarbert 也再次成為一家高度依賴監管政策的金融企業中最重要的對外代表之一。
站在公司的立場上，Tarbert 無疑是一名極具價值的主管。他熟悉監管體系的運作方式，也擅長調動政策、人脈和市場資源，總能在企業最需要的時候，幫助其跨越合規、融資與市場准入等關鍵門檻。
縱觀 Tarbert 的職業生涯，貫穿其中的始終是對政策週期和市場窗口的精準判斷。他真正擅長的，是將監管履歷累積的信譽、政策資源與市場機會，在不同階段轉化為個人最有價值的職業籌碼。
只是，當他一次次在監管機構與金融企業之間完成身份切換，並在合適的時點兌現收益時，承擔長期風險的不是他本人，而是那些相信其公開敘事的投資者。

title: 下修 Coinbase 營收預期！Benchmark 看好：最大利多藏在《CLARITY 法案》
summary:
Coinbase（美股代號 COIN）下周公布財報前夕，投資研究機構 Benchmark 開出第一槍，以近期加密貨幣交易降溫為由，下修 Coinbase 第二季獲利預測，但仍維持「買進」評等與 270 美元目標價。

〈下修 Coinbase 營收預期！Benchmark 看好：最大利多藏在《CLARITY 法案》〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
全美最大加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase（美股代號 COIN）下周公布財報前夕，投資研究機構 Benchmark 開出第一槍，以近期加密貨幣交易降溫為由，下修 Coinbase 第二季獲利預測，但仍維持「買進」評等與 270 美元目標價。分析師認為，相較於單季財報疲軟，美國《數位資產市場明晰法案（Clarity Act）》過關的潛在利多，才是真正能引爆股價飆升的催化劑。
第二季交易降溫 Benchmark 下修 Coinbase 營收預估
Benchmark 分析師 Mark Palmer 周三發布最新報告，將 Coinbase 第二季營收預測由原先的 15.1 億美元，下修至 13.8 億美元，並將 2026 年全年營收預估從 63.3 億美元調降至 60 億美元。
Mark Palmer 指出，Coinbase 第二季面臨相當艱困的營運環境。他表示，第二季期間，中心化交易所現貨交易量較前一季下滑約 28%，永續合約交易活動同步降溫，加上整體加密貨幣市值縮水約 13%，都對 Coinbase 的交易收入形成壓力。
儘管如此，Mark Palmer 觀察到加密貨幣市場在 6 月已初露回穩曙光，現貨交易量自 3 月以來首度重返 1 兆美元大關。他認為，這波資金回溫有望稍微緩解第二季財報的頹勢，但 Benchmark 團隊仍保守預估，Coinbase 第二季的交易手續費營收將出現逾 5% 的降幅。
Coinbase 股價周三早盤約落在 172 美元附近，單日下跌約 2%，今年以來累計跌幅則來到 27% 。若以 Benchmark 給出的 270 美元目標價推算，意味著 Coinbase 股價仍有高達 57% 的上漲空間。
Benchmark：真正的關鍵在《CLARITY 法案》
Benchmark 認為，對 Coinbase 投資人而言，更值得關注的並非第二季財報，而是下半年美國加密貨幣監管政策的發展。
Mark Palmer 指出，目前市場尚未充分反映《CLARITY 法案》的潛在價值，若法案最終闖關成功，Coinbase 將是最大受惠者之一。
就在 Benchmark 發布報告前一天，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）才對法案中最具爭議的「道德條款」點頭放行，等同掃除了美國這部加密貨幣市場架構法案的最後一道路障。
根據該草案規範，未來將明令禁止聯邦官員發行加密貨幣，並將執法權限交由司法部（DOJ）全權把關，為加密貨幣市場迎來更乾淨、透明的競技場。

title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
summary: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.
full_text:
Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
- Published
The deal between the US and Saudi Arabia to help the Gulf kingdom develop nuclear energy is dependent on Riyadh recognising the State of Israel, President Donald Trump has said.
"The Civil Nuclear Deal (There will be no enrichment of material!)... which pertains only to non-military use... will be approved, but is totally subject to Saudi Arabia joining the very respected and successful Abraham Accords," Trump said in a post on Truth Social.
The Trump-brokered Abraham Accords have led to five countries - including two Arab nations - recognising Israel.
Saudi Arabia has previously said it will not do so without the establishment of a Palestinian state.
- Trump's nuclear deal with Saudis jettisons longstanding US demands - Published2 hours ago
 
- Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi tanker as US launches more Iran strikes - Published54 minutes ago
 
During Trump's first term as US president, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Bahrain signed the Abraham Accords, resulting in a historic normalisation of relations between Israel and two Arab nations - the first in decades.
Sudan, Morocco and Kazakhstan have since also signed them, too.
Saudi Arabia has not so far responded to Trump's remarks, which come after criticism from experts that the deal announced on Wednesday could run the risk of future nuclear proliferation in an already unstable region.
And it was not immediately clear if the condition of joining the Abraham Accords was stipulated in the text of the nuclear deal - which has not been released - or that Saudi Arabia had agreed to that condition.
The BBC has contacted the White House for comment.
Meanwhile, Israel welcomed Trump's statement.
Posting on X, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office said Saudi Arabia joining the accords "would be an historic leap forward for peace in the Middle East".
The statement did not mention the nuclear deal. However, Israeli Economy Minister Nir Barkat said previously his country "can manage it" if Saudi Arabia had nuclear power for peaceful means.
Israel itself is widely believed to have nuclear weapons, but it neither confirms nor denies that this is the case.
The US-Saudi deal is described as a "peaceful nuclear co-operation agreement" that will provide "great access for American companies in the Saudi nuclear energy programme" by the US energy department.
The nuclear issue has been at the centre of the months-long US-Israeli conflict with Iran which has for years denied Western accusations that it aims to acquire nuclear weapons.
Saudi Arabia's de facto ruler, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, told CBS News in 2018 that his own nation was not planning to acquire a nuclear weapon, but that "without a doubt if Iran developed a nuclear bomb, we will follow suit as soon as possible".
Earlier US media reports suggested the deal could allow Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium in the future - which can be used as fuel for power plants, but also potentially to make nuclear bombs. However, Trump's remarks appear to deny this.
Rosemary Kelanic, the director of the Middle East programme at the US-based Defense Priorities think tank, said it would be "quite shocking" if the US were to allow Saudi Arabia uranium enrichment facilities.
"The US has never done that before. We have never helped another country enrich on their own soil," she said, adding that this was because "if you can produce your own nuclear fuel, you become a much bigger risk" for building nuclear weapons.
The agreement will now be sent to the US Congress for review.
Some lawmakers on both sides of the political aisle are expected to oppose the deal, though Trump's Republican Party controls both the upper and lower chambers and opponents of the deal do not appear to have the votes needed to block it.

title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
summary: The price of Brent crude rose more than 5% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.
full_text:
Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
- Published
Oil prices hit $100 a barrel for the first time since May as the escalating conflict in the Middle East reignited fears over global energy supplies.
Brent crude - the global benchmark for oil prices - rose more than 6% on Thursday following several days of increases as the US stepped up military strikes against Iran.
Prices spiked after Houthi militia in Yemen attacked oil tankers in the Red Sea, threatening a key export route that Saudi Arabia has used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz.
Gas prices have also risen steadily over the past month, with the benchmark UK gas price currently at around 150 per therm, up from around 98p at the end of June.
Oil prices had been falling following a temporary ceasefire between the US and Iran.
They dropped back to levels last seen before the US and Israel began military action against Iran on 28 February.
However, the ceasefire has failed and this week US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the people in charge in Iran were "not ready to make a deal".
The ongoing conflict risks pushing up inflation for many countries, including UK and the US leading to higher prices for consumers.
Higher oil prices typically lead to petrol and diesel becoming more expensive.
While drivers are affected directly, households could also see prices of other goods, such as food, increase due to businesses passing on higher transportation costs to customers.
Inflation rates have fallen in the UK and US, but questions remain whether the the slow down will prove short-lived due to the renewed conflict in the Middle East.
UK petrol prices have risen by 5p a litre in the space of two-and-a-half weeks to hit almost £1.56.
Diesel is at £1.72 a litre, on average, according to the RAC.
Average gasoline prices in the US have surpassed $4 a gallon once more, up from $3.92 a month ago, according to motorist advocacy group AAA.
Kevin Warsh, the newly-appointed chair of the US Federal Reserve, last week told Congress that the central bank had "no tolerance to persistently elevated inflation".
US President Donald Trump had pushed Warsh's predecessor, Jerome Powell, to cut interest rates.
Trump has made it clear he expects Warsh to fulfil his demand for reductions in borrowing costs for Americans.
But the Fed held US interest rates between 3.5% and 3.75% at Warsh's first meeting last month. He also told Congress that he was committed to "restoring price stability" in the wake of the Middle East conflict impacting prices.

title: Wildfires and record dry conditions trigger drought in parts of Wales
summary: Wales has seen about 5% of the average rainfall for July, after a series of back-to-back heatwaves.
full_text:
Wildfires and record dry conditions trigger drought in parts of Wales
- Published
Widespread wildfires, river levels approaching all-time lows and the mounting impacts of successive heatwaves have triggered a drought status for parts of Wales, Natural Resources Wales (NRW) has confirmed.
Wales has seen about 5% of the average rainfall for July, after a series of back-to-back heatwaves and a drier than usual April to June.
Afonydd Cymru, which represents Wales' rivers trusts, said low river flows were causing "significant problems", killing fish and other wildlife, while farming unions warned of failing crops and heat-stressed livestock.
NRW said the areas affected included North and South Gwynedd, Ynys Môn, also known as Anglesey, Dee, Clwyd and Upper Severn.
It is the first part of the UK to face an announcement of drought status so far this summer.
NRW announced last week that north and south-east Wales were moving to "prolonged dry weather" status - classed as a first step towards drought.
It triggered enhanced monitoring and checks of waterways and important sites for wildlife as well as advice for farmers and others who use water from rivers.
Now the regulator says the threshold has been reached for a drought to be declared across north and parts of mid Wales - based on exceptionally low river and groundwater levels, dry soils, impacts on wildlife, farming and forestry.
The rest of mid and south Wales was also now classed as being in "prolonged dry weather" status.
July is on course to become the driest in Wales for almost 190 years if significant rainfall does not arrive before the end of the month.
Rivers classed as exceptionally low include the Clwyd, Alwen, Alyn, Clywedog, Dyfi and Conwy in north Wales as well as the Wye, which runs through parts of mid Wales and south along the border with England.
Extra water was being released from reservoirs to support flows on the Clwyd and Wye, as well as the river Severn in the south east and the Dee in north-east Wales.
Rhian Thomas, sustainable water and nature manager at NRW, said: "The prolonged period of hot, dry weather we have experienced this summer is now having serious impacts on the environment across parts of Wales.
"We have seen rivers fall to exceptionally low levels, groundwater continuing to decline and increasing reports of environmental impacts affecting wildlife, fisheries, farming and sensitive habitats.
She added that the recent wildfires across north and south east Wales were "one of the clearest and most visible signs of how dry our landscapes have become".
"While drought status does not automatically mean water shortages for customers, it does reflect the growing pressure being placed on our environment," Thomas said.
"We are asking everyone to play their part by using water wisely and helping to protect Wales' natural resources during this exceptionally dry period."
What is an environmental drought?
An environmental drought occurs when a prolonged lack of rainfall and high temperatures cause severe stress on the natural ecosystem.
NRW says it results in critically low river flows, diminished reservoir reserves and exceptionally low groundwater levels, negatively impacting wildlife, fisheries and protected habitats.
This type of drought typically develops before agricultural impacts (like failing crops) or public water shortages occur. Impacts include:
- Shrunken rivers - a decrease in oxygen levels, an increase in water temperatures and a restriction in the migration of species like salmon 
- Habitat loss - reduced water levels cause riverbeds to dry up, leading to the loss of biodiversity and fish kills 
- Private water pressures - natural springs and private boreholes can run dry 
When environmental drought conditions, external are identified, NRW often transitions areas to a "prolonged dry weather" status.
This triggers enhanced monitoring of waterways, restricts water abstraction licenses to protect low flows and leads to the release of additional water from reservoirs into rivers.
Gail Davies-Walsh, chief executive of Afonydd Cymru, said the country's waterways were already under strain due to pollution.
"The lack of rainfall and decline in river flows is really starting to exacerbate water quality," she said.
"We've already had a couple of rivers that have dried up and we're getting reports through of fish that have been killed because of a lack of water."
High river temperatures were also leading to concerns for the survival of aquatic life, she added, with water temperatures as high as 28C recorded in the Wye and Usk.
Davies-Walsh said she was worried that people's frustrations at water companies over sewage spills and leakages was making them less likely to heed advice about being careful with their use of water.
"I'm looking at social media comments and I totally understand those frustrations," she said.
"But we've really got to think about the fact that our water usage is directly impacting the flow in our rivers and directly impacting fish and other wildlife's survival.
"We really need to do our little bit to protect them."
Tudur Roberts farms in Abergele, keeping 27 pedigree Angus cows and 200 sheep, and said the weather has been "really bad the last two weeks".
"It's dried up, we're on well water and the well's dried up, we've got one spring going.
"We've been carrying water up from the local town to supply the cows and things. It's getting really desperate for water," he said.
"[It's] a really tough time at the moment.
"We are majorly in drought already. I'm 1000ft above sea level, there's no mains or anything up there so [I'm] really, really struggling."
In the horticulture and flower marquees of the Royal Welsh Agricultural Show in Llanelwedd, Powys, both farmers and growers were talking about the weather's impacts.
"People are going to have to adapt, think about gathering their own water," said Paul Thomas of the National Vegetable Society.
"In the spring when it was crazy rain, everything was delayed - sowing and planting -because it was just relentless, and then it was almost like an off-switch," added garden and food writer Stephanie Hafferty.
"One of the things I noticed this morning is the trees are going into autumn colour, and that's a big worry, it's not even August yet."
Elen Hughes of Trelawnyd, Flintshire, said the fields on her family's farm were "bone dry, nothing's growing".
"They've just last week had to feed the second silage cut to the cows because there's no food for the cattle."
"We've had really dry weather but also it's been really hot - and those things combined if you're a livestock farmer means excessive pressure on livestock," said Abi Reader, president of NFU Cymru.
"You have to make sure they have enough water and shade, and we are getting farms with springs and streams drying up," she told BBC Walescast.
"If you're an arable farmer the heat and dry weather have also forced a lot of the crops to come to ripening a lot earlier than they normally would.
"It's unprecedented early harvesting this year and farmers are going to see lower crop yields."
Welsh Water emphasised that NRW's drought declarations were different to its own announcements.
The company has already brought in a hospipe ban for 33,000 properties in west Wales.
"NRW's drought status reflects environmental conditions, including factors such as rainfall, river flows and groundwater levels," a spokesperson said.
"By contrast, Welsh Water's Temporary Use Ban is an operational measure based on local water demand and our ability to replenish service reservoirs with drinking water at the same rate, or faster, than customers are using water.
"It is driven by the capacity of the local treatment works and distribution network to keep up with sustained demand.
"This means different parts of Wales can experience different operational pressures, even if they are not in the same environmental drought category declared by NRW."

title: Rayner rules out repaying severance cash after making cabinet return
summary: The returning housing secretary received £16,876 after leaving government in September 2025.
full_text:
Rayner rules out repaying severance cash after making cabinet return
- Published
Angela Rayner has told the BBC she will not repay a £16,876 ministerial severance payment after making her return to the cabinet.
The Labour MP resigned as deputy prime minister and housing secretary in September 2025 after failing to pay enough tax on her £800,000 flat in Hove, which resulted in the exit payout.
Rayner was reappointed as housing secretary by new Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Monday, prompting the Conservatives to press for her to return the money.
In 2023, Rayner said there was a "staggering lack of shame" from the Tories after it was revealed former ministers - some of whom later returned to the frontbench - were paid more than £450,000 in severance packages, external.
- Angela Rayner: Cabinet comeback for one of Labour's biggest names - Published1 day ago
 
- Angela Rayner settles tax bill with HMRC - Published14 May
 
A lump sum, equivalent of 25% of the annual ministerial salary, is payable when a minister stops holding office. Departing ministers who are aged over 65 or are reappointed within three weeks do not qualify.
The 2025/26 accounts, external for the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government record the severance payment for Rayner.
In her first interview since returning to government, Rayner was pressed on whether she would return the money.
She told Matt Chorley on BBC Radio 5 Live: "No, my severance payment was given to me at the time, I had worked in government for a period of time and then I came out of government for just under a year."
She added: "I will be delivering in government again."
Rayner earlier said her criticism of the Conservatives over severance payments came at a time when there was a "revolving door" which saw ministers return to government "after 40-odd days".
The Conservatives earlier this week said Rayner had "quit in disgrace and took a £17k payout" last year.
The party added: "Now she's got her old job back, will she return the cash? Or is it one rule for Labour, and another for everyone else?"
Rayner's departure last September came after the prime minister's ethics adviser, Sir Laurie Magnus, said she had "acted with integrity" but concluded that she had breached the ministerial code.
Sir Laurie said she did get legal advice when buying the property, but failed to seek further expert tax advice as recommended.
In May, Rayner resolved her tax affairs with HMRC following an investigation, settling £40,000 in unpaid stamp duty.
The MP for Ashton-under-Lyne said she had been "exonerated" of the accusation that she had "deliberately sought to avoid tax".
Rayner told Matt Chorley: "The situation I went through last year was really difficult, it was difficult for my family, but I felt I'd let people down and I never want to let people down, I want to fight for them."
Rayner also said she has "unfinished business" in government, including on building council houses and supporting local government.
Burnham has said he wants to deliver "the biggest council house building programme since the post-war period".
Asked for details to explain what this will look like, Rayner said she would not provide an "exact figure" or provide a date for when she considers the post-war period to have ended.
She said: "We want to aspire to get as far as possible and what we've done as a government is put more investment in that, the £39bn for social and affordable housing grant funding that we want to get out the door."

title: Pubs cheer business rates relief while other firms 'left out in the cold'
summary: Pubs welcomed the support package, while other High Street firms asked why they were left out.
full_text:
Pubs cheer business rates relief while other firms 'left out in the cold'
- Published
Andy Burnham's decision to cut business rates for pubs, social clubs and live music venues raised a cheer among industry bosses.
It was his third big policy announcement in three days, and as industry body UK Hospitality put it, it showed his enthusiasm for the sector "survived his trip down the M1".
Tax experts said the 20% discount, which comes on top of emergency business rates relief rolled out in January, would save the average pub more than £1,000.
But other High Street businesses complained they would miss out on the support and called for the package to be extended.
'Good start, but tax system needs to be fairer for pubs'
Keith Bott, who runs the Titanic Brewery and nine pubs across the Midlands, said the government was "finally recognising the plight of the hospitality industry and trying to help".
He said pubs had been hit by a mix of employer National Insurance increases, the rising minimum wage, high inflation and the climbing cost of living.
Meanwhile, the sector is "heavily taxed", with around 35-40% of turnover going to the Treasury, he added.
"What I really liked in this announcement is they are recognising we need to look at a fairer tax system so we can all contribute to society," Bott told the BBC. He said online retailers that operate out of warehouses pay a "ridiculously low" amount of business rates in comparison, and "we need to make the system fair".
And Bott urged the government to go further in supporting the industry, cutting the duty on draft beer to target drinks sold in pubs.
'Why is our business being overlooked?'
Missing out on support in Burnham's plans is Ruth Dawson's HD3 Fitness Centre in Huddersfield. The local gym "does exactly the kind of work the government says it wants to support", she told the BBC, but has been "left out in the cold".
Dawson said her firm faces a "damaging" business rates bill, which is "one of the biggest threats to our ability to keep operating".
"If a pub can get support because it is the 'heart of the community', then so should we," she added.
"A community gym that keeps elderly residents mobile, active and connected is every bit as vital to a High Street as a pub or a club - arguably more so, given the pressure on the NHS and social care from an ageing population."
She urged the government to rethink the plans, extending support to community leisure centres and fitness facilities.
'I am not sure where this leaves me'
Nick Smith, who runs the Ludoquist board game cafe and bar in Croydon, London, said Burnham's announcement was reminiscent of "the trauma of Covid days".
"Where the government makes an announcement and you have to spend days trawling websites to try to find out what they mean," he told the BBC.
Ludoquist is a licenced premises, but Smith said it does not meet the government definition of a "pub", so he fears being missed by the business rates package.
"It is not inconceivable that I am in fact a pub. But I don't think I am. No-one would describe me as a pub. I'm a cafe/bar/restaurant.
"Cafes aren't being helped any more, nor are restaurants, so I don't understand the logic of that
But Smith said business rates are not the main challenge for Ludoquist, calling instead on the government to reduce the current 20% rate of VAT for hospitality businesses in line with European countries such as Germany, France, Spain and Italy which charge less.
'VAT is the real problem'
Sam Lamiroy said Burnham's announcement is a step in the right direction and shows the government is trying to help, but agrees with Nick Smith that "VAT is the real problem".
He said the turnover of a typical pub or restaurant can easily be between £500,000 and £1m, meaning a £1,000 saving "won't make much difference".
"The 20% drop in business rates is really just lip service, it won't affect whether we survive or not, the real lever to pull is help with VAT, dropping the rate from 20% to 10% as it is in the rest of Europe," he told the BBC.
Lamiroy also said he fears his Penzance-based bar and restaurant, 45 Queen Street, will not be considered a "pub" and so be ineligible under the terms of the support package.
And, urging the government to do more to support hospitality businesses, he said: "These are the first jobs for a lot of young people, it is a springboard into work.
"When these places shut, it's not just my business and income that disappears, it is the entire team."

title: Johnson-Thompson and Asher-Smith out of Commonwealths
summary: Olympic silver medallist Katarina Johnson-Thompson pulls out of the Commonwealth Games because of injury.
full_text:
Johnson-Thompson and Asher-Smith out of Commonwealths
- Published
Olympic silver medallist Katarina Johnson-Thompson has pulled out of the Commonwealth Games because of injury.
Dina Asher-Smith and 400m Olympic silver medalist Matt Hudson-Smith, who were both set to run relays for Team England in Glasgow, have also been replaced, as has Asher-Smith's sprint team-mate Daryll Neita and 400m runner Amber Anning.
Johnson-Thompson, 33, was due to compete in her third Commonwealth Games heptathlon, having won gold on the Gold Coast in 2018 and at Birmingham in 2022.
But she said she has "not been able to get back to the level" needed to compete and will instead focus on being fit for the European Championships next month.
"Missing a championship is never easy, but I know it's the right decision," she said.
Johnson-Thompson has been replaced in England's squad by Niamh Emerson, who took bronze behind Johnson-Thompson in 2018.
The withdrawal of such high-profile names is a significant blow to the event on the day the opening ceremony takes place.
Renee Regis, Ebuka Nwokeji, Tara Simpson-Sullivan and Tom Keen have all been added to England's athletics squad in Glasgow. The track and field competition begins on Monday.
England's Olympic 800m champion Keely Hodgkinson had already skipped the event to prioritise the European Championships, which begin in Birmingham on 10 August, leading many to question the event's significance in the sporting calendar.
St Lucia's 100m Olympic champion Julien Alfred has also pulled out of the Glasgow Games, while Canadian swimmer Summer McIntosh, one of the sport's biggest stars, is favouring the Pan Pacific Swimming Championships.
With the likes of the United States, China and major European nations not part of the Commonwealths, some athletes favour other, more competitive events.
These Games were also hurt by the late confirmation of its dates and schedule, which only came in October last year. The event was originally scheduled for March, but the Australian state of Victoria pulled out as hosts in 2023.
Speaking on Thursday, organisers insisted the event would be a success despite the absence of some big names.
Scottish athletics medal hopes include new mile world record holder Josh Kerr and defending 10,000m champion Eilish McColgan, while Glasgow 2026 chief executive Phil Batty said focus should be on younger athletes.
"We have got an incredible field of athletes," he said.
"It is really important to make sure we have those athletes at the pinnacle of their career and you can see that across the sports.
"It is equally exciting to see, just like what happened in 2014 [previous Glasgow Games], which athletes this starts that breakthrough moment."
Commonwealth Sport chief executive Katie Sadlier said her organisation would have conversations with other events in the future to create a clearer window.
Sadlier said: "This Games was a little bit of a challenge because we only had 18 months and it was really difficult to say 'where is the gap in the two-year period?'.
"As we move forward more of those conversations will happen."

title: Google fined €890m by EU for favouring its own apps over rivals
summary: It is the first major enforcement action against the tech giant under the EU's new digital rules.
full_text:
Google fined €890m by EU for favouring its own apps over rivals
- Published
Google has been fined €890m (£759m) by the EU for allegedly abusing its power by favouring its own apps and services over those from rivals.
It is the first major action against the tech giant under the EU's Digital Markets Act (DMA), a landmark law aimed at curbing the power of the world's biggest tech companies.
The Commission argued Google's practices limited consumer choice and gave its own services an unfair advantage over rivals.
But the firm criticised the decision, arguing the EU's requirements could damage services used by millions of European customers.
"To comply, we are having to strip away real-time Search features Europeans love - like instant pricing and direct availability for hotels, flights and restaurants - and dismantle safety protections on Google Play," said Google's president of global affairs Kent Walker.
"This isn't fair competition."
EU officials rejected that argument, saying the measures are necessary to prevent dominant platforms from disadvantaging rivals.
The total fine handed down to Google comprises of two separate breaches of the DMA.
The European Commission imposed a €460m penalty after finding Google favoured its own services for helping people book flights and hotels over competitors in search results.
And it gave the firm a further €430m fine due to its Play Store rules, with regulators saying it didn't allow people to be shown cheaper offers available outside Google's own marketplace.
Google has a long history of disputes with European regulators, having previously received billions of euros in fines over separate competition cases.
EU competition chief Teresa Ribera said companies should succeed because of the quality of their products - rather than their market position.
"The best products should succeed because they're better, not because they're owned by the company running the search engine," she said.
EU tech boss Henna Virkkunen echoed those thoughts.
"After this decision, we want to make sure that there is more competition and also other companies are able to innovate," she said.
Google now has 60 days to comply with the regulations - or challenge them by taking the Commission to court.

Love Island: All Stars winners Molly Smith and Tom Clare marry

Love Island: All Stars winners Molly Smith and Tom Clare have tied the knot.
The couple, who won the first series of the spin-off edition in 2024, announced on Instagram, external they were "just married" alongside a photo of them kissing while flower petals floated around them.

title: MI5 to pay damages for illegal surveillance of journalist's phone
summary: It is believed to be the first time that MI5 has been directed to pay compensation to a journalist.
full_text:
MI5 to pay damages for illegal surveillance of journalist's phone
- Published
MI5 and the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) have been ordered to pay £20,000 in damages to a journalist, after they illegally obtained his phone records.
Former BBC Journalist Vincent Kearney took a case at the Investigatory Powers Tribunal (IPT) in London.
It is believed to be the first time that MI5 has been directed to pay compensation to a journalist.
Kearney was the subject of secret operations aimed at discovering his confidential sources while he worked at the BBC in Belfast.
In a statement welcoming the judgement, Kearney said: "I am delighted that the court has penalised those responsible for breaking the law.
"The fact it decided to award damages reflects the seriousness of the case.
"It is important that agencies charged with upholding the law know that they are not above the law and will be held to account."
The BBC, who brought the case alongside Kearney, said: "Today's findings are welcome, necessary and significant.
"We hope that their effect will be to protect journalists and their freedom to report and investigate stories into the future."
Kearney worked for BBC Northern Ireland for 18 years until 2019, when he joined RTÉ, where he is currently its northern editor.
There were multiple operations targeting him between 2006 and 2014, when he was a BBC correspondent covering policing and security issues.
Four of them were run by the PSNI, who also created a "profile" on him, which included car registrations and the names of his wife and mother-in-law.
He suspects it was for surveillance purposes.
1,580 calls and texts
MI5, the PSNI and, on its behalf, the Metropolitan Police, covertly obtained his mobile phone records, enabling them to see numbers in contact with him, and when.
Other data they accessed revealed the subscriber names and addresses in respect of the caller numbers.
They could also see the locations of where calls were made from.
The information did not include the content of those calls or any text messages.
The authorisations used were "disproportionate" and broke the law on privacy and the protection of confidential journalistic sources.
One operation alone involved trawling through information relating to 1,580 calls or texts he made and received.
Kearney first became aware of some unlawful actions in 2024, following an earlier IPT case brought by two other Northern Ireland journalists.
'Public interest'
But the scale of the "interferences with his journalistic data" only became apparent through legal disclosure at the IPT.
The IPT is an independent judicial body which investigates complaints about surveillance by public authorities.
In its judgement, the IPT stated: "It is not in dispute that his journalism has made an important contribution to the debate on matters of importance in Northern Ireland."
It said the protection of sources is "not for the benefit of the journalist personally", but for "the public interest" in receiving information from him.
MI5 and the PSNI will each pay Kearney £10,000.
They told the IPT their actions reflected problems with the legislation at the time.
PSNI Chief Constable Jon Boutcher accepted the tribunal's findings and apologised to Mr Kearney.
He said the authorisations were "not in accordance with the law" and were disproportionate.
Boutcher said "significant changes to practice and policy" had been made since the events took place, adding that the PSNI remained committed to using its powers "in a way that is lawful and in the public interest.
The National Union of Journalists (NUJ) welcomed the ruling, with its assistant general secretary Séamus Dooley describing it as a "landmark judgement".
He said the findings gave a "deeply worrying insight" into the treatment of journalists and represented a "damning indictment" of those responsible.
Mr Dooley said the judgement reinforced the union's call for a judge-led inquiry into the unlawful surveillance of journalists, lawyers and human rights defenders.

title: Ex-Coronation Street actor to receive 'substantial' libel damages from the Sun publisher
summary: Qasim Akhtar is to receive "substantial" damages to settle a High Court libel claim from a story last eyar.
full_text:
Ex-Coronation Street actor to receive 'substantial' libel damages from the Sun publisher
- Published
Former Coronation Street actor Qasim Akhtar is to receive "substantial" damages from the Sun's publisher, to settle a High Court libel claim.
Akhtar who played Zeedan Nazir in the ITV soap from 2014 to 2018 and then 2021 to 2023, sued News Group Newspapers (NGN) earlier this year.
A story in the Sun had falsely alleged Akhtar had "backed" and "teamed up with" Islamic cleric Uthman ibn Farooq, was associated with extremism, radicalisation and violence, and had "moved to Pakistan" and "trained with guns".
The newspaper previously apologised "unreservedly" to the actor for the "serious harm and distress caused to him by the publication of these false allegations".
The story, published in November, appeared in The Sun online and in print.
The Manchester-born actor, who has previously appeared in TV shows including Shameless and Waterloo Road, did not attend the court proceedings.
But his lawyer, Daniel Taylor, read out an agreed statement, saying NGN had agreed to pay "substantial damages" and Akhtar's legal costs.
"The defendant has accepted that the publication of the article caused serious harm to Mr Akhtar's reputation and also caused him great distress," he said.
"This included reputational harm to his family life and business, which he was forced to put on hold pending the matter being resolved.
"The libel was compounded by the fact that the defendant has acknowledged that it failed to obtain Mr Akhtar's response to these very serious allegations prior to publication."
'Deeply affected me'
Andrew Wheelhouse, for NGN, responded: "The defendant acknowledges that the article should never have been published and has undertaken never to repeat the allegations."
In an Instagram post in June, Mr Akhtar said that the previous six months had been "very tough to say the least" and that the allegations in the article "deeply affected me, my reputation, my family, my safety and my peace of mind".
In its apology published in May, The Sun said it accepted that the allegations in the article were "entirely false".
It said: "Mr Akhtar has never endorsed or supported any such views and strongly condemns all forms of extremism and violence.
"He has never been involved in or associated with radicalisation nor has he, as further falsely claimed, moved to Pakistan and undertaken firearms training."

title: Garnacho joins Villa on loan from Chelsea
summary: The loan will become a permanent transfer should "certain criteria be met".
full_text:
Garnacho joins Villa on loan from Chelsea
- Published
Aston Villa have announced the loan signing of Chelsea winger Alejandro Garnacho until the end of the 2026-27 season.
The 22-year-old's transfer will "become permanent next summer should certain criteria be met", said the Blues, with the Argentine already agreeing a four-year contract at Villa Park.
The terms of the obligation to buy clause have not been disclosed by either club, but it is expected to be triggered if conditions, such as the number of appearances Garnacho makes next season, are met.
Chelsea believe the terms are easily reachable and they will achieve their original £43m valuation.
Garnacho's departure from Stamford Bridge follows Chelsea's signing of Morgan Rogers for a record £117m fee from Villa on Tuesday.
Villa head coach Unai Emery said he was "delighted" with Garnacho's arrival.
"He is so talented, young and he showed us his wish to help our project. We are really happy," he added.
The winger becomes Villa's fourth signing, after the arrivals of Johan Manzambi, Joao Gomes and Modou Keba Cisse.
Villa's player sales this summer, meanwhile, total nearly £200m, with Rogers, Youri Tielemans, Donyell Malen, Enzo Barrenechea and Lewis Dobbin all leaving.
The Blues have been keen to offload Garnacho despite signing him only last September in a £40m deal from Manchester United, who would be due 10% of any eventual transfer fee.
His impact at Stamford Bridge has been limited to one Premier League goal, and the arrivals of Rogers and Sporting winger Geovany Quenda have increased the need to reduce the size of the squad.
- Garnacho, Rogers and two clubs trying to balance the books - Published1 hour ago
 
Garnacho will need to raise his game - analysis
Garnacho arrives at Aston Villa still with more promise than pedigree.
Emery has shown faith in moving for the eight-cap Argentina international as he looks to rebuild his squad at Villa Park.
With Rogers moving to Stamford Bridge for a club-record sale of £117m, the club needed to act.
They have been fluid in the market, an important stance given their finances and the general nature of the window, and Garnacho - who also interested Roma - represented a good opportunity.
Emery wanted a pacy winger and, with the option of an initial loan with an obligation to buy if certain clauses are met, the deal also gave Villa a degree of control over finances given they must still tread lightly with the Premier League's and Uefa's financial fair play rules.
Should the move become permanent - and Garnacho has already agreed a four-year contract - then he will have achieved something other attackers have not when on loan at Villa.
Marcus Rashford, Jadon Sancho and Harvey Elliott joined previously with varying degrees of success in their temporary moves.
Rashford's 17-game spell at Villa Park in 2024-25 led to an England return, while Sancho flattered to deceive and Emery left Elliott in limbo with his decision not to play him more, to avoid triggering an obligation for a permanent transfer.
Clearly surplus to requirements at Chelsea, Garnacho does not want to return to somewhere he is not needed.
A return of one goal and four assists in 24 Premier League games for the Blues last season - or eight goals in 43 appearances in all competitions - suggests he will need to raise his game to meet the level Emery demands.
Eight assists and 16 goals in 93 games at Manchester United also shows Garnacho's end product must improve at Villa.
There is clearly talent there and it is now up to him to show it, and for Emery to harness it.

title: Arsenal sign Greece forward Tzolis for £34m
summary: Arsenal sign "extremely versatile attacking player" Christos Tzolis from Club Brugge for £34m.
full_text:
Arsenal sign Greece forward Tzolis for £34m
- Published
Arsenal have signed "extremely versatile attacking player" Christos Tzolis from Club Brugge for £34m.
The 24-year-old Greece international has joined the Premier League champions on what they describe as a "long-term contract".
Tzolis scored 43 goals and provided 45 assists in 108 appearances for Club Brugge.
He joins Arsenal after the departure of Belgium forward Leandro Trossard to Besiktas earlier this month
"Christos naturally operates on the left but is comfortable across the frontline," said Arsenal sporting director Andrea Berta.
"He's an excellent finisher with both feet, thrives in tight spaces, and possesses incredible technical ability.
"Christos has produced outstanding numbers in terms of goals and assists over the last three seasons, and he's a player who will raise the technical level of our squad, while bringing positive energy, enthusiasm, and a strong mentality to our team."
Tzolis, who started his career at PAOK, made 30 appearances for Norwich between 2021 and 2024, scoring three goals.
During his time at the club he had spells on loan at Twente and Fortuna Dusseldorf before joining Club Brugge.
Tzolis, who made his Premier League debut for the Canaries in a 1-0 defeat at Arsenal in September 2021, said he had a "nice conversation" with Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta.
"We talked about everything - about the club, about myself, about his plans, about me of course, about the team," he said. "It was only positive things.
"I'm a direct player, I go for goals or assists. That's my point of view as an attacker, as a winger.
"I'm always hungry to score or to give the final pass to my team-mates. And I can say I work hard for the team, also in the defensive part."
Set-piece specialist with eye for goal - analysis
Tzolis arrives in north London on the back of the best season of his career, but it has taken him time to show his quality.
The Greek forward struggled to make an impact during a three-year spell at Norwich City, scoring three times in 30 appearances, but rebuilt his career away from Carrow Road.
After impressing on loan in the 2023-24 season at German second-tier side Fortuna Dusseldorf, where he scored 24 goals in 35 games, he left Norwich for Club Brugge in 2024 and quickly established himself as one of Belgium's most productive attacking players.
Last season, the 24-year-old was directly involved in a league-high 40 goals, scoring 17 times and providing 23 assists as Club Brugge were crowned league champions.
His influence extended beyond goals and assists. Tzolis created more chances (135) than any other player in Belgium's top flight, and also recorded the most progressive carries (359) and successful dribbles (40).
He also proved he could deliver against Europe's leading clubs, scoring against Atalanta and Atletico Madrid in the Champions League, while registering an assist against Barcelona.
Predominantly a right-footed left winger, Tzolis is comfortable across the frontline and possesses quality from set-pieces. Of the 135 chances he created in the Belgian Pro League across the 2025-26 campaign, 52 came from dead-ball situations (38.5%).
Although Trossard recorded more goal involvements in last season's Champions League for Arsenal, the Greece international produced almost twice as many chances (13 to seven) and completed more passes in the final third (138 to 80).
